svg.title: STICKFRAG

svg.text: IF IT DOES NOT START, CLICK ANYWHERE

svg.script:
<!doctype html> <!-- stickfrag.html - the whole game in one self-contained file. Generated by tools/build-single.py; rebuild with ./tools/build-all.sh.
The home page is the real stickfrag.com landing page, whole: the header, the hero, the news rows, the #play section and the footer are all here and the page scrolls exactly as it does live. The game's markup is inert inside a <template> and its module text is parked in a type="text/plain" script until PLAY, so the menu costs no WebGL context. See SHELL in the builder for why. --> <html lang="en" translate="no" data-ads="soon"> <head> <meta charset="utf-8" /> <meta name="google" content="notranslate" /> <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" /> <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'self'; script-src 'nonce-hbDcUhS5tAM4Og8F' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' blob: data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' blob: wss://broker.emqx.io:8084 wss://broker.hivemq.com:8884 wss://test.mosquitto.org:8081; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'" /> <title>StickFrag</title> <meta name="description" content="StickFrag, standalone: a stickman shooter in one file." /> <link rel="icon" href="data:," /> <script nonce="hbDcUhS5tAM4Og8F">window.__SF_ASSETS = { "/loadout-he.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/loadout-knife.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/loadout-lmg.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/loadout-pistol.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/loadout-smg.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/map-farm-night.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/map-farm.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/map-freight.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/map-hospital2.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/map-junction.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/map-town.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/map-yard.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/items/hat.none.webp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "/favicon.svg": "data:image/svg+xml;base64," }; (function () { var table = window.__SF_ASSETS || {}; var fix = function (v) { return (typeof v === "string" && table[v]) ? table[v] : v; }; var setAttr = Element.prototype.setAttribute; Element.prototype.setAttribute = function (name, value) { return setAttr.call(this, name, name === "src" ? fix(value) : value); }; var protos = [HTMLImageElement.prototype, HTMLSourceElement.prototype]; for (var i = 0; i < protos.length; i++) { var d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(protos[i], "src"); if (!d || !d.set) continue; (function (desc) { Object.defineProperty(protos[i], "src", { get: desc.get, set: function (v) { desc.set.call(this, fix(v)); }, configurable: true }); })(d); } document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { var nodes = document.querySelectorAll("[src]"); for (var j = 0; j < nodes.length; j++) { var want = table[nodes[j].getAttribute("src")]; if (want) nodes[j].setAttribute("src", want); } }); })();</script> <style id="sf-home-css">/* landing-site.css: part of landing.html's styles, linked from it in order (the cascade depends on the order). */ /* Same tokens as the game shell (index.html) and client/src/art/palette.ts. */ :root { --paper: #fff4dc; --horizon: #fcefd6; --ink: #15111c; --ink-soft: #4a4252; --red: #ef4d4d; --blue: #3d7cf2; --yellow: #ffd23f; --green: #2fae72; --sky: #86c8ec; --sand: #f0d9a8; --sand-shade: #cdb59f; --cyan: #4fb3d9; --coral: #ef6f6c; --pink: #f28fb1; --plate: #3d7cf2; --discord: #5865f2; --font: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; --head: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; --gutter: clamp(16px, 4vw, 48px); --max: 1180px; } * { box-sizing: border-box; } [hidden] { display: none !important; } html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 76px; } body { margin: 0; background: var(--sand); color: var(--ink); font: 17px/1.55 var(--head); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; overflow-x: hidden; } img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; } a { color: inherit; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 3px; } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px var(--yellow); } p { margin: 0 0 1em; } h2, h3 { margin: 0; line-height: 1.1; text-wrap: balance; } .wrap { width: min(var(--max), 100% - 2 * var(--gutter)); margin-inline: auto; } .num { font-family: var(--font); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
/* Comic print primitives: paper, ink border, hard offset shadow, halftone. */ .panel { background: var(--paper); border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--ink); } .dots { background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.14) 22%, transparent 25%); background-size: 10px 10px; } .logo { font: 900 28px/1 var(--head); letter-spacing: -1px; color: var(--red); -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .logo .tld { /* ".COM" as the maps' signs paint it (art/logo.ts): the same letters at 0.42 of the word, on its baseline */ margin-left: 0.04em; font-size: 0.42em; letter-spacing: -0.04em; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 1px; text-shadow: 1.5px 1.5px 0 var(--ink); } .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 22px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); font: 900 17px/1 var(--head); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } .btn:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } .btn.big { padding: 18px 34px; font-size: 26px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--ink); } .btn.paper { background: var(--paper); }
/* ---------- Top bar ---------- */ .bar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; background: var(--paper); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); } .bar .wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; height: 64px; } .bar nav { display: flex; gap: 22px; margin-left: auto; font-weight: 800; } .bar nav a { text-decoration: none; } .bar nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .bar .fb-btn { padding: 9px 14px; font-size: 15px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } .fb-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } /* Discord stays in the bar on phones too, as its icon alone. */ .bar .discord-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .discord-link svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; color: var(--discord); } @media (max-width: 860px) { .bar nav .opt { display: none; } .discord-link span { display: none; } .bar .wrap { gap: 14px; } .bar .btn { padding: 9px 14px; } } /* Phones: the bubble alone, so logo, links and PLAY still fit on one line. */ @media (max-width: 480px) { .bar .fb-btn { padding: 9px 10px; } .fb-btn span { display: none; } } /* Very narrow phones (320 px): a smaller logo and tighter gaps, or PLAY pushes the page sideways. */ @media (max-width: 380px) { .bar .wrap { gap: 8px; } .bar .logo { font-size: 22px; } .bar nav { gap: 10px; } .bar .btn { padding: 9px 10px; } }
/* ---------- Feedback form (client/src/feedback.ts, the same form as in the game) ---------- */ #feedback { position: fixed; z-index: 40; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: min(480px, calc(100vw - 32px)); max-height: calc(100vh - 32px); overflow-y: auto; padding: 20px 22px; /* The second shadow dims the page behind the card. */ box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--ink), 0 0 0 100vmax rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.45); } #feedback[hidden] { display: none; } #feedback h2 { font: 900 28px/1 var(--head); margin-bottom: 8px; } .fb-lead { margin: 0 0 10px; font-weight: 700; } .fb-kinds { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 14px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 800; } #fb-text { display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 8px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; font: 14px var(--font); resize: vertical; } #fb-status { min-height: 18px; margin: 6px 0; font-weight: 800; } .fb-row { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; } .fb-note { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft); }
/* ---------- Hero: the yard scene ---------- */ .hero { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--sky) 0%, #b9def0 45%, var(--horizon) 62%); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); } .scene { width: 100%; /* Slim: the yard is a banner, and "Gear up" below shows above the fold. */ height: clamp(380px, calc((100vh - 64px) * 0.6), 540px); } .scene .t { font-family: var(--head); font-weight: 900; } .cloud { animation: drift 46s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .cloud.slow { animation-duration: 70s; } .blimp { animation: drift 30s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; } @keyframes drift { from { transform: translateX(-30px); } to { transform: translateX(40px); } } .spot { cursor: pointer; outline: none; } /* Opacity only: a CSS transform would replace the tag's SVG transform attribute. */ .spot .tag { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.15s; pointer-events: none; } .spot:hover .tag, .spot:focus .tag, .spot:focus-visible .tag { opacity: 1; } .spot:focus-visible .hit { stroke: var(--yellow); stroke-width: 8; } .join { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .join input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 700 20px var(--head); outline: none; } .join input:focus { background: #fffbe9; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--yellow); } .join-error { min-height: 22px; margin: 6px 0 4px; color: #b3261e; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; } .phone-note { margin: 14px 0 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .sale-hint { position: absolute; right: var(--gutter); bottom: 16px; white-space: nowrap; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; background: var(--yellow); border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); transform: rotate(1.5deg); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .scene { height: 320px; } .sale-hint { position: static; display: block; width: fit-content; max-width: calc(100% - 2 * var(--gutter)); margin: 0 auto 24px; translate: none; white-space: normal; transform: none; } }
/* landing-home.css: part of landing.html's styles, linked from it in order (the cascade depends on the order). */ /* While ads are off there is no hero (owner, 2026-10-06: a new picture comes later); the page's h1 is in #play. */ [data-ads='soon'] .hero { display: none; }
/* ---------- Sections ---------- */ section { padding: clamp(56px, 9vw, 104px) 0; } .sec-head { max-width: 720px; margin-bottom: 40px; } .sec-head h2 { font: 900 clamp(32px, 4.6vw, 52px) / 1.02 var(--head); letter-spacing: -1.5px; margin-bottom: 14px; } .sec-head p { font-size: 19px; max-width: 62ch; } .page-title { margin: 0 0 22px; font: 900 clamp(38px, 5.6vw, 68px) / 0.95 var(--head); letter-spacing: -2px; } .page-title small { display: block; margin-top: 12px; font: 800 clamp(17px, 1.8vw, 21px) / 1.25 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--red); }
/* Gear up: the 3D corner (client/src/lobby.ts draws it) and the name + headband + body card */ .gear { background-color: var(--sky); background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.12) 22%, transparent 25%); background-size: 10px 10px; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); } /* The stage spans the page (owner, 2026-10-05); under it three small cards: the room code, PLAY, the level. After PLAY the menu takes the whole row (playMenu.ts sets data-step). The row's rule (2026-10-05, owner: "tidy up, cards of similar size"): three slots on the stage's columns, each card fills its slot, one height (at least --menu-h), one 28 px overhang, 8 px shadows, at most 1° of tilt. Small links go on a line under the row. */ .gear-grid { --menu-cols: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); --menu-gap: 36px; --menu-h: 150px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--menu-cols); grid-template-areas: 'stage stage stage' 'code menu menu'; gap: 28px var(--menu-gap); align-items: start; } .gear:not([data-step='gear']) .gear-grid { grid-template-areas: 'stage stage stage' 'menu menu menu'; } .gear:not([data-step='gear']) .under-stage { display: none; } .gear:not([data-step='gear']) .gear-card { justify-self: center; width: min(100%, 860px); } /* Under the stage, each step takes its own height: the steps not shown take no room. */ .menu-steps > .step.off { display: none; } /* A comic panel: the corner is cropped by its ink frame, like a close-up. */ .gear-stage { grid-area: stage; position: relative; aspect-ratio: 2 / 1; /* PLAY, under the stage, must stay above the fold on a laptop: a short window makes the stage wider instead of taller (the camera keeps him the same size in the frame). */ width: 100%; max-height: max(360px, 100svh - 300px); overflow: hidden; /* A still of the scene until lobby.ts draws it live (a different aspect crops the still). */ background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--sky), #b9def0); border: 4px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 var(--ink); transform: rotate(-0.4deg); } /* The live scene fades in over the still (owner, 2026-10-06: no hard swap). The still has no stickman, so he fades in with the scene in his own colours, never in the default ones. */ #gear-canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.45s ease-out; } #gear-canvas.drawn { opacity: 1; } /* Faded in, the scene is transparent above the yard: the sky shows there (lobby.ts adds settled). */ .gear-stage:has(#gear-canvas.settled) { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--sky), #b9def0); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #gear-canvas { transition: none; } } /* The haven has no still yet: its warm dark wall until it draws, not the armory's. */ .haven-boot .gear-stage, .haven-boot .gear-stage:has(#gear-canvas.settled) { background: #6e3a22; } /* The first version's colour cards must not show before arrangeHaven (playMenu.ts) adds `haven`, which hides them for good: a slow or retried script left them on the wall (item 182). Wherever they are: a page opened under 861px wide once moved them off the stage, past every rule below. */ .haven-boot .gear-stage > .looks, .haven-boot .looks { display: none; } .gear-card { grid-area: menu; padding: 20px 24px; transform: rotate(1deg); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--ink); } /* Step 1 has no card of its own: the "who" card and a big PLAY hang over the stage's bottom edge, like the room-code ticket beside them (owner, 2026-10-05). */ .gear[data-step='gear'] .gear-card, .gear[data-step='start'] .gear-card { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-top: -56px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; box-shadow: none; transform: none; } /* Step 1's three cards take one height: the row's cells stretch, and the "who" card and PLAY stretch down the menu's boxes to it. */ .gear[data-step='gear'] .under-stage, .gear[data-step='gear'] .gear-card { align-self: stretch; } .gear[data-step='gear'] .gear-card, .gear[data-step='gear'] #step-gear { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .gear[data-step='gear'] .menu-steps, .gear[data-step='gear'] .gear-join { flex: 1; } /* Every card in the row is one kind of card (owner, 2026-10-05: "each card similar design, same palette, on hover too"): ink border, 8 px shadow, a tilt of at most 1° (--tilt), the room-code ticket's dashed perforation, ink text on a soft fill. Under the pointer a card lifts and its shadow grows; a press pushes it into the page. */ #gear .row-card { position: relative; border: 3px solid var(--ink); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--ink); transform: rotate(var(--tilt, 0deg)); transition: transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.1s; } /* The perforation: a pseudo-element, so the focus outline stays free for the keyboard. */ #gear .row-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6px; border: 2px dashed rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.4); pointer-events: none; } #gear .row-card:hover, #gear .row-card:focus-visible { transform: translate(-3px, -3px) rotate(var(--tilt, 0deg)); box-shadow: 11px 11px 0 var(--ink); } #gear .row-card:is(button):active { transform: translate(4px, 4px) rotate(var(--tilt, 0deg)); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #gear .row-card { transition: none; } } /* After PLAY (owner, 2026-10-05): no card, and the stage's three columns, so each button lands where step 1 had a card: CREATE ROOM where the room code was, the modes where the "who" card was, QUICK JOIN where PLAY was, all at step 1's height. BACK is the small line under them. The heading stays for screen readers. */ .gear[data-step='start'] .gear-card { justify-self: stretch; width: auto; } #step-start:not(.off) { display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--menu-cols); grid-template-areas: 'create modes quick' 'back . .'; gap: 22px var(--menu-gap); } #step-start .back { grid-area: back; justify-self: start; margin: 0; } #step-start .choice.create, #step-start .mode-tiles, #step-start .choice.quick { min-height: var(--menu-h); } /* Pink like the room-code ticket: rooms are the friends' way in. */ #step-start .choice.create { --tilt: -1deg; grid-area: create; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-width: 0; padding: 18px 24px; background: var(--pink); } /* CREATE ROOM's plus, so it reads at a glance. */ .start-icon { flex: none; width: 46px; height: 46px; } .start-icon rect { fill: var(--ink); } .start-icon .plus { stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; } #step-start .start-text b { margin-bottom: 4px; font: 900 30px/1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.02em; white-space: nowrap; } #step-start .choice.create .start-text b { font-size: 28px; } #step-start .start-text span { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } /* The mode buttons (playMenu.ts), where step 1's "who" card was: big short names in the mode's colour, the humans playing under each. */ .mode-tiles { grid-area: modes; display: grid; grid-auto-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-auto-flow: column; gap: 16px; min-width: 0; } /* A soft tint of the mode's colour, as light as the pink and the yellow beside it. */ #step-start .choice.mode-tile, #step-start .choice.mode-tile:hover, #step-start .choice.mode-tile:focus-visible { background: var(--mode-soft); } #step-start .choice.mode-tile { --tilt: 0.8deg; display: grid; place-content: center; padding: 10px 6px; text-align: center; } #step-start .choice.mode-tile:nth-child(even) { --tilt: -0.8deg; } #step-start .mode-tile b { margin: 0; font: 900 26px/0.95 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.02em; } #step-start .mode-tile span { margin-top: 6px; font: 800 13px var(--head); } #step-start .mode-tile span:empty { display: none; } #step-start .choice.quick { --tilt: 1deg; grid-area: quick; display: grid; place-content: center; padding: 18px 20px 16px; text-align: center; } #step-start .choice.quick b { font-size: clamp(30px, 3vw, 40px); white-space: nowrap; } #step-start .choice.quick > span { display: block; overflow: hidden; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } /* phoneMode (playMenu.ts) hides the computer's PLAY form with `hidden`; the grid below would win. */ #gear .gear-join[hidden], #gear #gear-phone[hidden] { display: none; } .gear-join { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--menu-gap); } .who-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; --tilt: 0.6deg; min-height: var(--menu-h); padding: 18px 24px 8px; } .who-card input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 700 20px var(--head); outline: none; } .who-card input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--yellow); } .who-card .gear-who { margin: 0 0 10px; align-items: baseline; } .who-card .gear-who b { font: 900 26px/1.1 var(--head); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .who-card .xp { margin: 0; padding: 0; gap: 10px; border: 0; background: none; box-shadow: none; } .who-card .join-error { min-height: 0; margin: 0 0 6px; } .who-card .join-error:empty { display: none; } /* A name that cannot be used: red frame, faded red text, and a grey PLAY that does nothing (owner, 2026-10-06). The class comes from playMenu.ts, showNameError. */ .gear-join.name-bad input { border-color: #b3261e; color: rgb(179 38 30 / 0.55); } .gear-join.name-bad input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(179 38 30 / 0.25); } #gear .play-big:disabled, #gear .play-big:disabled:hover { background: #d8d3c8; color: #8d877c; border-color: #8d877c; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #8d877c; cursor: not-allowed; transform: rotate(var(--tilt, 0deg)); } #gear .play-big:disabled::after { border-color: rgb(141 135 124 / 0.5); } .btn.big.play-big { --tilt: 1deg; min-height: var(--menu-h); padding: 20px; font-size: 56px; } .gear-card h2 { font: 900 clamp(36px, 4.6vw, 54px) / 1 var(--head); letter-spacing: -1.5px; margin-bottom: 10px; } .gear-label { margin: 4px 0 8px; font-weight: 900; } .swatches { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .swatch { width: 34px; height: 34px; background: var(--swatch); border: 3px solid var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } .swatch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .swatch:has(input:checked) { outline: 4px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .swatch:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 4px dashed var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } /* Not unlocked yet (client/src/gear.ts): faded under paper, with the level that unlocks it. Every colour shows, so the player sees the whole range to earn; hover still tries it on. */ .swatch.locked { display: grid; place-items: center; background: linear-gradient(rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.6), rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.6)), var(--swatch); border-style: dashed; cursor: help; } .swatch.locked span { font: 900 10px var(--head, sans-serif); color: var(--ink); }
/* ---- The look, on the stage: two rows of colours, each with a line to the part it colours ---- */ .looks { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 14px; } .gear-stage > .looks { position: absolute; top: 4%; right: 2.5%; width: 37%; height: 90%; align-content: space-between; gap: 0; z-index: 2; } .look-card { padding: 10px 12px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fffbe9; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink); transform: rotate(0.8deg); } .look-card[data-part='body'] { transform: rotate(-1.2deg); } .look-card .gear-label { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 900 18px var(--head); } .looks .swatches { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--cols, 9), minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; } .looks .swatch { width: auto; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 1; } .looks .swatch:has(input:checked) { outline-width: 4px; outline-offset: 3px; } /* Plain squares of colour, no frame at all, locked ones included (owner, 2026-10-05). Two classes deep, to beat the later .swatches label rule. The picked one keeps its ink outline. */ .swatches .swatch { border: 0; } .look-lines { display: none; } .gear-stage > .looks .look-lines { display: block; position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; } .gear-stage .look-lines polyline { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 7 5; } /* ---- The haven (the home page since 2026-10-06, client/src/havenMode.ts; owner): the 3D room fills the whole first section, the controls float on it. Top middle the level stripe, his name card just under it over his head; PLAY at the bottom middle, the room code to its right; the colour cards left of him; the Locker column at the far left. ---- */ .gear.haven { position: relative; padding: 0 !important; overflow: hidden; } .gear.haven .gear-stage { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: auto; aspect-ratio: auto; max-height: none; border: 0; box-shadow: none; transform: none; z-index: 0; /* ---- The Locker (client/src/locker.ts): a button on the stage, a panel over the colour cards ---- */ .locker-open { position: absolute; top: 4%; left: 2.5%; z-index: 3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 12px 8px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fffbe9; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink); color: var(--ink); font: 900 15px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.04em; /* ---------- "Works on" block (item 147): systems and browsers, plain icons ---------- */ .works-on { margin-top: 34px; padding: 20px 24px; } .works-on h3 { margin-bottom: 10px; } .works-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px 32px; } .works-label { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 800 13px/1.2 var(--font); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .works-cols > div { min-width: 0; container-type: inline-size; } /* Equal cells: 4 across when the column is wide, else 2 x 2, so no chip ever wraps alone. */ .works-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; } @container (min-width: 540px) { .works-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } } .works-list li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; padding: 5px 11px 5px 8px; border: 2.5px solid var(--ink); border-bottom-width: 4px; background: #fff; font: 800 15px/1.2 var(--head); white-space: nowrap; } .works-list svg { flex: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .works-note { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 15px; } .works-note + .works-note { margin-top: 2px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .works-cols { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } @media (max-width: 420px) { .works-on { padding: 16px 16px; } .works-list { gap: 6px; } .works-list li { gap: 5px; padding: 5px 6px 5px 5px; font-size: 14px; } .works-list svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } }
/* A calmer first hour (item 377): <html data-fh> lists the steps still closed (client/src/firstHour.ts). */ html[data-fh~='locker'] #locker-open, html[data-fh~='daily'] #daily-card, html[data-fh~='streak'] #new-card { display: none !important; }
/* landing-cards.css: the haven's cards of item 571 (owner's pick, draft A "Three cards and a slot", docs/design/play-menu.md, "571"). Linked after landing-home.css, before landing-touch.css. Left column: LOCKER, PACKS, SIGN IN, EVENT & NEWS. Right: today's list and one tip. After PLAY: three mode tiles and the pink WITH FRIENDS card. All of them are the game's cards (.row-card). */
/* ---- The left column ---- */ #gear .locker-side { width: min(330px, 23vw); gap: 18px; } #gear .lk-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 16px 18px; background: #fffbe9; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; --tilt: -0.8deg; } .lk-head img, .lk-head svg { display: block; flex: none; width: 60px; height: 60px; } .lk-text { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; flex: 1; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; } .lk-text b { font: 900 22px/1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .lk-text small { font: 700 13px var(--head); color: var(--ink-soft); } .lk-chips { display: flex; gap: 5px; margin-top: 4px; } .lk-chips i { width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); } .lk-chips i.none { border-style: dashed; background: none !important; } .lk-go { flex: none; font: 900 28px/1 var(--head); } /* PACKS: one line; red once packs wait (locker.ts). */ #gear .side-btn { padding: 14px 18px; } #gear .side-btn .lk-go { margin-left: auto; } #gear .side-btn:not(.has-packs) .lk-go { display: none; }
/* ---- SIGN IN: one small orange button until the progress is saved (owner, 2026-10-17) ---- */ .signin-card { display: grid; align-self: start; padding: 0; } .signin-card #signin-title, .signin-card .signin-why, .signin-card .signin-note { display: none; } /* The button is the PACKS line's twin (.side-btn .row-card: width, height, perforation, tilt, shadow, font), filled with the yellow of the top bar's PLAY (--yellow; the owner calls it orange, 2026-10-17). */ #gear .signin-btns .side-btn { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; justify-content: flex-start; background: var(--yellow); --tilt: -0.5deg; } /* Saved: one line with the account, a tick and a way into the sheet. */ .signin-card.saved { padding: 0; background: #fffbe9; } .signin-line { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 18px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink); font: 900 15px var(--head); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .signin-line[hidden] { display: none; } .signin-line b { color: var(--green); font-size: 18px; } .signin-line i { margin-left: auto; font: 900 24px/1 var(--head); }
/* ---- EVENT & NEWS: one slot, the poster of the event on or coming, the newest release under it ---- */ .ev-slot { display: grid; gap: 12px; } /* Bottom left of the room, level with PLAY (owner, 2026-10-17). */ .gear.haven .ev-slot.haven-float { bottom: var(--haven-lift); left: 2.5%; width: min(330px, 23vw); } .ev-slot .side-title { margin: 0; } .slot-poster { display: grid; gap: 8px; min-height: 150px; padding: 16px 18px; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 70% 0%, #6b3fa0 0%, #2b1e3f 60%); color: var(--paper); text-decoration: none; --tilt: 0.5deg; } .slot-poster[hidden] { display: none; } .slot-poster:not([href]) { cursor: default; } .slot-poster.poster-room { cursor: pointer; } .poster-line { /* Clear of the ghost and the pumpkin in the corner. */ padding-right: 64px; font: 700 13px/1.2 var(--head); color: var(--paper); } .poster-pill { justify-self: start; padding: 5px 7px; background: #b9f26b; color: var(--ink); font: 800 12px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .poster-name { display: grid; font: 400 32px/0.95 'Bowlby One', 'Arial Black', Impact, sans-serif; color: #b9f26b; -webkit-text-stroke: 1.5px var(--ink); text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } .poster-dates { font: 700 13px var(--head); color: rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.9); } /* The artifact's ghost (WBXJE5aC9crFk5WbmaPxHa, draft A): a rounded sheet with two eyes, and a pumpkin beside it; CSS only, no picture to load. */ .poster-ghost { position: absolute; right: 20px; bottom: 18px; width: 54px; height: 66px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 27px 27px 6px 6px; background: rgba(229, 255, 214, 0.9); } .poster-ghost::before, .poster-ghost::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 22px; width: 8px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink); } .poster-ghost::before { left: 13px; } .poster-ghost::after { right: 13px; } .poster-pumpkin { position: absolute; right: 82px; bottom: 18px; width: 40px; height: 32px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50% 50% 46% 46%; background: #ff8a1f; } .poster-pumpkin::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 13px; top: -9px; width: 7px; height: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: #2fae72; } /* The small Overwatch teaser over the poster (havenEvent.ts, drawOverwatch): night blue, a red pill, a scope. */ .slot-ow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 6px 10px; padding: 12px 16px; background: radial-gradient(120% 120% at 80% 0%, #2a5d78 0%, #0f1d2b 65%); color: var(--paper); --tilt: -0.4deg; } .slot-ow[hidden] { display: none; } .slot-ow > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ow-pill { grid-column: 1; background: #ff4d4d; color: #fff; } .ow-text { grid-column: 1; font: 900 14px/1.25 var(--head); color: #ffd23f; } /* A sniper scope: a ring, the cross and a red dot on its middle; CSS only. */ .ow-scope { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 3; width: 40px; height: 40px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #ff4d4d 0 3px, transparent 4px), linear-gradient(var(--ink), var(--ink)) center / 2px 100% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--ink), var(--ink)) center / 100% 2px no-repeat, rgba(214, 240, 255, 0.85); } /* The live card (reviewCard.ts, item 443): the teaser becomes one link to the case page. */ .slot-ow.live { display: block; padding: 0; } .ow-link { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 6px 10px; padding: 12px 16px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ow-link:hover .ow-text, .ow-link:focus-visible .ow-text { text-decoration: underline; } .ow-go { grid-column: 1; font: 700 12px/1.2 var(--head); color: var(--paper); } .ow-note { grid-column: 1; font: 700 12px/1.2 var(--head); color: #ff9d9d; } .ow-thanks { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; } .ow-thanks .ow-scope { display: none; } .ow-open { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2 / 4; align-self: center; padding: 6px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 900 13px/1 var(--head); text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .slot-ow.live .ow-scope { grid-row: 1 / 4; } /* Short screens: the slot grows up from PLAY's level into the left column, so the teaser goes first (below 960 px: at 1600x900 its label sat on the Sign in card, item 805), the poster gets compact (below 820 px), and below 830 px the news card keeps its title line only (at 1366x768 the label sat on the Sign in card). */ @media (max-height: 960px) { #gear.haven .slot-ow:not(.live) { display: none; } /* The live review card (item 443) takes the news card's place: both do not fit. */ #gear.haven:has(.slot-ow.live:not([hidden])) .slot-news { display: none; } } @media (max-height: 830px) { #gear.haven .news-lines { display: none; } } @media (max-height: 820px) { #gear.haven .slot-poster { min-height: 0; padding: 12px 16px; } #gear.haven .slot-poster .poster-name { font-size: 26px; } } .slot-news { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 18px; background: #fffbe9; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; --tilt: -0.6deg; } .slot-news[hidden] { display: none; } .news-pill { flex: none; padding: 5px 7px; background: var(--blue); color: #fff; font: 800 12px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } /* The pill sits on the name's line; the three lines hang under the name (owner, 2026-10-18). */ #gear .slot-news { align-items: flex-start; } .news-body { position: relative; z-index: 1; flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 5px; } .news-text { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font: 900 14px/1.3 var(--head); } .news-lines { display: grid; gap: 3px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .news-lines li { position: relative; padding-left: 13px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font: 700 12.5px/1.3 var(--head); color: rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.82); } .news-lines li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.5em; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--blue); } .news-go { align-self: center; } .news-go { flex: none; font: 900 22px/1 var(--head); } /* The old Friends Weekend card gave way to the poster; its section below is still opened from the poster. */ #gear.haven .event-card { display: none !important; }
/* ---- The Locker panel: tabs HEAD / HATS / BODY ---- */ .lk-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); } .lk-tab { flex: 1; margin: 0 0 0 -3px; padding: 12px 6px; border: 0; border-left: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 900 15px/1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; } .lk-tab:first-child { border-left: 0; } .lk-tab[aria-selected='true'] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--yellow); } .lk-pane { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 0; } .lk-pane[hidden] { display: none; } .lk-pane[data-tab] { overflow-y: auto; } .lk-label { margin: 0; padding: 16px 16px 8px; font: 900 15px var(--head); } .lk-hint { margin: 0; padding: 4px 16px 0; font: 700 13px/1.35 var(--head); color: var(--ink-soft); } .lk-hint[hidden] { display: none; } .lk-pane .swatches { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px 8px; } .lk-pane .swatch { width: auto; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 1; } .lk-pane .swatch.locked span { font-size: 9px; }
/* ---- Right side: today's list (no bars) and one tip ---- */ #gear .daily-card { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 18px; } #gear .daily-card .daily-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } #gear .daily-card .daily-title { padding: 5px 9px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 800 12px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.13em; } #gear .daily-card .daily-left { margin-left: auto; font: 700 12px var(--head); color: var(--ink-soft); } #gear .daily-card .daily-rows { display: grid; gap: 11px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } #gear .daily-card .daily-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; box-shadow: none; font: 800 15px/1.2 var(--head); } #gear .daily-card .daily-bar { display: none; } #gear .daily-card .daily-tick { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; font-size: 14px; } #gear .daily-card .daily-row.done .daily-tick { background: var(--green); color: #fff; } #gear .daily-card .daily-row.done .daily-text { text-decoration: line-through; opacity: 0.55; } #gear .daily-card .daily-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } #gear .daily-card .daily-count { flex: none; padding: 3px 5px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; font: 800 12px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-style: normal; } #gear .daily-card .daily-pay { margin: 0; font: 700 12.5px/1.35 var(--head); color: var(--ink-soft); } /* One tip at a time: a big key cap, a title, one line; arrows and dots. */ #gear .tips-card { width: 100%; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 18px; } .tip-top { display: flex; align-items: center; } .tip-count { margin: 0; padding: 5px 9px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 800 12px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.13em; } .tip-arrows { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 4px; } .tip-arrows button { width: 32px; height: 28px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink); font: 900 24px/1 var(--head); cursor: pointer; } .tip-body { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; } .tip-key { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; min-width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0 8px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-bottom-width: 6px; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; font: 900 24px/1 var(--head); } .tip-key.long { font-size: 15px; } .tip-body p { display: grid; gap: 3px; margin: 0; } .tip-body b { font: 900 19px/1.15 var(--head); } .tip-body span { font: 700 13px/1.3 var(--head); color: var(--ink-soft); } .tip-dots { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; } .tip-dots button { width: 11px; height: 11px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .tip-dots button.on { background: var(--ink); }
/* ---- After PLAY on the haven: PICK A MODE, three tiles that join at once, WITH FRIENDS ---- */ .pick-label { display: none; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) .pick-label { display: block; margin: 0; padding: 7px 10px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 800 13px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.13em; white-space: nowrap; } /* CREATE ROOM is the pink card's button now (WITH FRIENDS); QUICK JOIN stays, a slim line. */ #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #start-create { display: none; } #gear.haven .mode-tiles .mode-tile { align-content: start; justify-items: start; gap: 8px; min-height: 0; padding: 16px 16px 14px; text-align: left; } #gear.haven .mode-tiles .mode-tile > b:not(.tile-name) { display: none; } #gear.haven .mode-tile .tile-name { display: block; font: 900 clamp(22px, 1.9vw, 30px)/1.02 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.02em; } #gear.haven .mode-tile .tile-blurb { margin: 0; font: 700 14px/1.3 var(--head); } #gear.haven .mode-tile .tile-live { margin: 0; padding: 5px 8px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 800 12px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } #gear.haven .mode-tile .tile-live::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #57e38f; } #gear.haven .mode-tile .tile-live:empty { display: none; } #gear.haven .mode-tile .tile-join { align-self: end; justify-self: stretch; margin: auto 0 0; padding: 13px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 18px/1 var(--head); text-align: center; } #gear:not(.haven) .tile-name, #gear:not(.haven) .tile-blurb, #gear:not(.haven) .tile-join { display: none; } #gear.haven .tile-name, #gear.haven .tile-blurb, #gear.haven .tile-join { display: block; } /* The pink card beside the tiles: the room-code card, shown here with the pick. */ #gear.haven[data-step='start'] #code-card { display: block; position: absolute; left: auto; right: 4%; bottom: var(--haven-lift); translate: none; width: min(300px, 21%); min-height: 0; } .gear.haven[data-step='start'] .haven-float:is(.play-big, .haven-toprow) { display: none; }
/* Short screens (update 1.7 check, 2026-10-24): the right column stacks four cards and the room-code card floats over its lower ones, so the lowest go first; at 720 px the news card goes too, or the EVENT & NEWS label sits on the Sign in card. */ @media (max-height: 960px) { #gear.haven #hunt-card { display: none; } } @media (max-height: 830px) { #gear.haven #pass-strip { display: none; } } @media (max-height: 740px) { #gear.haven #streak-card, #gear.haven .slot-news { display: none; } }
/* landing-servers.css: the server list is back (item 631, owner 2026-10-18), and the pieces of the home menu that came with it: the first page hides the EVENT & NEWS slot while the Locker is open, the "ALL SERVERS" button and the big CREATE A ROOM after PLAY, the mode chips that filter the list. Linked after landing-cards.css. The list's rows are the game's row cards (landing-home.css, .row-card). Phones: landing-touch.css. Design: docs/design/play-menu.md, "631", and server-list.md. */
/* The Locker panel and the slot stood on the same corner of the first page (owner's picture 1). */ #gear:has(#locker:not([hidden])) .ev-slot { visibility: hidden; }
/* ---- After PLAY: ALL SERVERS above the tiles' right end ---- */ #start-servers { white-space: nowrap; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start #start-servers { position: absolute; z-index: 3; bottom: calc(var(--haven-lift) + var(--quick-h) + 18px + var(--tiles-h) + 8px); left: calc(50% + var(--row-w) / 2); translate: -100% 0; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); }
/* ---- WITH FRIENDS: the big CREATE A ROOM, the code under it ---- */ #gear.haven[data-step='start'] #code-card:not([hidden]) { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; width: min(310px, 22%); padding: 18px 20px 20px; } #gear.haven[data-step='start'] #code-card h3 { margin: 0; } #gear.haven[data-step='start'] #code-create { min-height: 78px; font-size: clamp(18px, 1.35vw, 24px); letter-spacing: 0.02em; white-space: nowrap; } #gear.haven[data-step='start'] .code-or { display: block; margin: 0; font: 800 12px/1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } #gear.haven[data-step='start'] .code-error { margin: 0; }
/* ---- The server step: a board over the room, as the friends room is ---- */ #gear.haven[data-step='servers'] #gear-canvas { visibility: hidden; } #gear.haven[data-step='servers'] .gear-grid { align-content: center; padding-bottom: 24px; } .gear.haven[data-step='servers'] .gear-card { width: min(1040px, 92vw); } .server-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .server-title { margin: 0 auto 0 0; font: 900 18px var(--head); } /* The region choice beside the title, with each region's ping (playMenuServers.ts, drawRegions). */ .server-region { margin-left: 6px; padding: 3px 6px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 700 13px var(--head); cursor: pointer; } #server-quick { white-space: nowrap; } /* The mode chips filter the list: ALL, then one per mode in its colour. */ .mode-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 14px; } .mode-chip { padding: 7px 16px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 900 14px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.04em; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } .mode-chip[data-game] { border-left: 8px solid var(--mode); } .mode-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--yellow); } .mode-chip[data-game][aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--mode); color: #fff; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); } .mode-chip[aria-pressed='false']:hover { background: #fffbe9; } /* The name search (item 638) and the names under a row. */ .server-find { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 700 14px var(--head); } .server .names { grid-column: 2 / -1; margin-top: 6px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .server.has-names .mode { grid-row: 1 / span 2; } /* Mode · server · match · players · ping · join; each cell a bold line over a small one. */ .server-cols, .server { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr 1.7fr 1fr 0.7fr auto; align-items: center; column-gap: 10px; } .server-cols { padding: 0 24px 6px 3px; font: 900 11px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .server-cols > span:first-child { text-align: center; } .servers { display: grid; gap: 14px; max-height: min(54vh, 460px); overflow-y: auto; padding: 2px 10px 12px 2px; } .server > span { display: grid; min-width: 0; } .server small { font: 600 12px var(--head); color: #7a7366; } #gear .server.row-card { --tilt: 0deg; width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px 12px 0; background: var(--paper); text-align: left; font: 700 14px var(--head); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } #gear .server.row-card:hover:not(:disabled), #gear .server.row-card:focus-visible { background: #fffbe9; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--ink); } #gear .server.row-card:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } .server.full { opacity: 0.55; } /* The mode is the card's own left end, in big letters and the mode's colour. */ .server .mode { align-self: stretch; place-items: center; margin: -12px 0; padding: 0 8px; border-right: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--mode, var(--ink)); } .server .mode b { color: #fff; font: 900 20px/1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-align: center; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); } .server .match b { font-size: 13px; } .server .ping.good { color: #1d8a3a; } .server .ping.ok { color: #b07a00; } .server .ping.bad { color: var(--red); } .server .join { padding: 3px 8px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); font: 900 13px var(--head); } .server.full .join { background: #e3d8c2; } .server-note { margin: 6px 0 0; font-weight: 700; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .server-cols { display: none; } .server { grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; column-gap: 8px; } .server .names { white-space: normal; } .server .match, .server .ping { display: none !important; } }
/* ---- Item 634 (owner, 2026-10-18, from the local dev screenshot) ---- 1. A mode card is the button: no JOIN inside it. 2. QUICK JOIN is as big as PLAY on the first page (min(440px, 31%) by 158 px), the mode cards a smaller row above it. 3. CREATE A ROOM is one big pink button; no room code on this step (room links still work). 4. ALL SERVERS is bigger, with a servers icon. `html` in front: landing-board.css loads after this file and sets the same custom properties. */ html #gear.haven .mode-tile .tile-join { display: none; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start:not(.off) { --quick-w: min(440px, 31%); --quick-h: 158px; --tiles-h: 112px; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .choice.quick { width: var(--quick-w); flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .choice.quick b { font-size: clamp(34px, 3.3vw, 54px); line-height: 1; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .choice.quick > span { font-size: 15px; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .mode-tile { padding: 12px 14px; gap: 8px; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .mode-tile .tile-name { font-size: clamp(18px, 1.5vw, 23px); } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .mode-tile .tile-blurb { display: none; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .back { left: calc(50% - var(--quick-w) / 2 - 24px - 64px); } /* CREATE A ROOM: the pink card itself is the button, PLAY's height, right of QUICK JOIN. */ html #gear[data-step='start'] #code-card:not([hidden]) { padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; box-shadow: none; } html #gear[data-step='start'] #code-card::after, html #gear[data-step='start'] #code-card :is(h3, .code-or, .code-join, .code-error) { display: none; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch'])[data-step='start'] #code-card:not([hidden]) { left: calc(50% + min(220px, 15.5%) + 30px); right: auto; width: min(290px, 20%); height: 158px; } html #gear[data-step='start'] #code-create { flex: 1; width: 100%; min-height: 78px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--pink); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 clamp(22px, 1.9vw, 32px)/1.05 var(--head); white-space: normal; rotate: -1deg; } html #gear[data-step='start'] #code-create:hover, html #gear[data-step='start'] #code-create:focus-visible { translate: -3px -3px; box-shadow: 11px 11px 0 var(--ink); } /* ALL SERVERS: bigger, with its icon. */ #start-servers { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } #start-servers .servers-icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } #start-servers .servers-icon circle { fill: currentColor; stroke: none; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start #start-servers { padding: 11px 18px; font-size: 18px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink); }
/* ---- Item 639 (owner, 2026-10-18, second screenshot) ---- 1. No "PICK A MODE · YOU JOIN AT ONCE" label. 2. CREATE A ROOM has the row cards' dashed perforation, as the other cards. 3. /* landing-menu.css: part of landing.html's styles, linked from it in order (the cascade depends on the order). */ /* The play menu (client/src/playMenu.ts): one step shows at a time, the stage stays. */ .gear { padding-block: clamp(20px, 3.5vw, 44px); /* Room for the squad ribbon, which overlaps this section's bottom edge. */ padding-bottom: 60px; } /* One step shows at a time; the others are hidden and inert (playMenu.ts, show). } .xp-lv { padding: 6px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 22px/1 var(--head); white-space: nowrap; transform: rotate(-3deg); } /* The owner's level (glitch.ts): the level badge's own colours, two flickering characters instead of a number (owner, 2026-10-06). */ .glitch { display: inline-block; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .choices { display: grid; gap: 12px; } .choices.maps { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .choice { display: block; width: 100%; font: 900 34px/1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.18em; user-select: all; } .code-hint { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } /* Under the stage: the room-code ticket only. scale: 1.05; } } .new-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 9px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--red); color: #fff; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 20px/1.1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.04em; rotate: -4deg; } .new-close { position: absolute; top: 15%; right: 12%; width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 900 14px/1 var(--head); cursor: pointer; } .new-card h3 { margin: 7px 0 3px; font: 900 19px/1.05 var(--head); text-transform: uppercase; } .new-card h3 a { color: var(--ink); } .new-credit { display: none; } .new-card h3 { font-size: 14px; } .new-stamp { font-size: 15px; } } /* Stacked, the stage spans the screen: a small sticker on its corner, the stamp and the title only. */ @media (max-width: 860px) { .new-card { --bw: 150px; padding: 18px 24px 10px; background: var(--pink); --tilt: -1deg; } .code-card h3 { font: 900 22px/1.1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 12px; } .code-join { display: flex; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; outline: none; } .code-join input::placeholder { color: #b9b0a0; } .code-join input:focus { background: #fffbe9; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--yellow); } .code-join .btn { padding: 9px 16px; font-size: 15px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } .code-or { font: 800 14px var(--head); } /* The friends room's settings on the invite step: mode, map, bots. */ .room-setup { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 16px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fffbe9; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } .room-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 52px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .room-label { font: 900 13px var(--head); text-transform: uppercase; } .room-seg { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .room-seg button { padding: 6px 11px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 900 14px var(--head); white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } .room-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--yellow); } .room-seg button:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: none; } /* The room's map: small square pictures in a row, the name under each (owner, 2026-10-05). */ .room-seg .map-pick { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 4px 3px; font-size: 12px; } .map-pick img { display: block; width: 64px; height: 64px; object-fit: cover; border: 2px solid var(--ink); } .bots-switch.room-bots { position: static; justify-self: start; padding: 2px 0; font: 800 15px var(--head); transform: none; } .code-error:empty { min-height: 8px; } /* Squad: a Discord-blue ribbon tilted across the page, like a strip of tape over the play menu's bottom edge (docs/design/discord.md). padding-inline: 0; } } .squad + .event, .squad + .event[hidden] + .week { /* Their 72 px, plus what the ribbon covers. */ padding-top: 100px; } .squad-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; letter-spacing: -0.5px; color: var(--yellow); -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } .social-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .btn.discord { /* As tall as the icon links beside it (40 px). */ padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 16px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); background: var(--paper); } .btn.discord svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; color: var(--discord); } .icon-link { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink);
