/* landing-sections.css: part of landing.html's styles, linked from it in order (the cascade depends on the order). */ /* Three rows under the event section (item 212, docs/design/play-menu.md). Row 1: this week's top. Row 2: the thank-you card beside every quote; on a narrow window it stacks, the card first. Row 3: the latest updates (owner, 2026-10-16: under the support row). */ .duo { padding: 64px 0 0; } .duo + .duo { padding-top: 72px; } .duo-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 40px 48px; } /* The weekly top is alone in its row, as wide as a column of row 2 so names stay near their XP, and the row stays out until the server answers. */ .news-row .duo-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 620px); } .news-row:has(.week[hidden]) { display: none; } .duo h2 { font: 900 clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px) / 1.05 var(--head); letter-spacing: -1.2px; margin-bottom: 10px; } .duo-grid > div > p { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 17px; } .week, .latest { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; } .week .scoreboard { align-self: stretch; } .week-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 18px; margin-top: 26px; } .week-reset { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink-soft); }
/* The newest releases (src/updates.ts, HOME_RELEASES), the same cards as on /support/, side by side. */ .releases { align-self: stretch; display: grid; gap: 14px; margin: 4px 0 22px; } .updates-row .releases { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); } .release { padding: 12px 18px 4px; background: #fff; border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink); } .release h3 { font: 900 20px/1.2 var(--head); } .release h3 a { text-decoration: none; } .release h3 a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .release ul { margin: 6px 0 8px; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.45; } .release li + li { margin-top: 4px; } .release .when, .release .more { margin: 2px 0 6px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-soft); } .release .more a { font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); }
/* Row 2, left: his 3D stickman (src/supportScene.ts) lies on the top edge of the yellow thank-you card, as on /support/. The canvas reaches into the card by 13.5% of its width, so his back rests on the edge, and the card's top padding leaves room for his propping elbow. The canvas's empty top half reaches up into the row's padding, so his halo is level with the quotes' title. He is a little wider than the column (owner, 2026-10-09: "a bit bigger"); the canvas's sides are empty. */ .thanks-col { --man: min(600px, 112%); align-self: start; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .sits { display: flex; justify-content: center; margin: calc(var(--man) * -0.2) 0 calc(var(--man) * -0.135); position: relative; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; } #halo-man { display: block; width: var(--man); aspect-ratio: 2.2; } .thanks { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 30px); padding-top: calc(var(--man) * 0.05 + 30px); background: var(--yellow); border: 4px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 var(--ink); text-align: center; } /* White with the page's ink outline and hard shadow, like the event's sticker title (owner, 2026-10-09). */ .thanks h2 { color: #fff; letter-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } .thanks p { margin: 0 auto 12px; max-width: 520px; font-size: 17px; } .thanks .btn { margin-top: 6px; } .thanks .tip-note { margin: 16px auto 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-soft); }
/* Row 2, right: every quote, at their own height. The list scrolls inside its box when it grows past 560 px. */ .quotes { max-height: 560px; overflow-y: auto; /* Room for the cards' tilts and hard shadows inside the scroll box. */ padding: 10px 12px 16px 6px; /* A loose pile of stickers next to each other, each as wide as its words (owner, 2026-10-09: "not so perfect"): tilts, colours and nudges change with the card's place in a cycle of 5. */ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-content: flex-start; align-items: flex-start; gap: 18px 16px; } .quote { flex: 0 1 auto; /* Under half the column, so two or three fit on a line. */ max-width: calc(50% - 12px); margin: 0; padding: 9px 14px; background: #fff; border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink); } .quote:nth-child(5n + 1) { transform: rotate(-2.2deg); } .quote:nth-child(5n + 2) { background: var(--paper); transform: rotate(1.6deg) translateY(8px); } .quote:nth-child(5n + 3) { background: #ffe9f1; transform: rotate(-1deg) translateX(14px); } .quote:nth-child(5n + 4) { background: #e8f4fc; transform: rotate(2.6deg) translateY(-4px); } .quote:nth-child(5n) { background: #fff3b0; transform: rotate(-1.6deg) translate(-6px, 6px); } .quote blockquote { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; } .quote blockquote::before { content: '“'; } .quote blockquote::after { content: '”'; } .quote figcaption { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-soft); } @media (max-width: 860px) { .duo-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .quotes { max-height: 520px; } /* Stacked, the canvas must not be wider than the screen. */ .thanks-col { --man: min(600px, 100%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .quote { transform: none !important; } }
/* This week's top players (leaderboard.ts, showWeeklyTop): a light paper card, like the update cards beside it (owner, 2026-10-09: light, not the dark Tab look). */ .scoreboard { padding: 16px 18px 10px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 9px 9px 0 var(--yellow), 9px 9px 0 3px var(--ink); transform: rotate(1deg); } .week-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0 0 8px; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 6px; } .week-rows li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 10px 6px 6px; background: var(--paper); border: 2px solid var(--ink); } .week-rows li:nth-child(1) .rank { background: var(--yellow); } .week-rows li:nth-child(2) .rank { background: #dcdde4; } .week-rows li:nth-child(3) .rank { background: #e7a76a; } .week-rows li.me { background: #fff3b0; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } .week-rows .rank { display: grid; place-items: center; height: 26px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 900 14px/1 var(--head); } .week-rows .name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 16px; } .week-rows .lv { padding: 1px 5px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); font: 900 11px/1.2 var(--head); } .week-rows .pts { min-width: 7ch; text-align: right; color: var(--ink); font: 800 14px var(--font); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .drops { margin: 16px 0 6px; } .drops h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 900 18px var(--head); } .drop-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 4px; } .drop-rows li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; background: var(--paper); border: 2px solid var(--ink); font-size: 14px; } .drop-rows li.epic, .drop-rows li.limited { background: #fff3b0; } .drop-rows .what { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .drop-rows .pts { color: var(--ink); font: 800 12px var(--font); } .week-empty, .week-me { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; } @media (max-width: 860px) { .code-card, .gear[data-step='gear'] .gear-card, .gear[data-step='start'] .gear-card { margin: 0; } /* Stacked, the main action comes first, then the modes, then the friends room. */ #step-start:not(.off) { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: 'back' 'modes' 'quick' 'create'; } } /* The friends row carries its own "Bots" switch on the right (playMenu.ts, withBotsSwitch). */ .choice-wrap { position: relative; } .choice-wrap .choice { padding-right: 142px; } .bots-switch { position: absolute; right: 16px; top: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 4px; font: 900 18px var(--head); cursor: pointer; transform: translateY(-50%); transition: transform 0.08s; } /* It rides along when the row lifts under the pointer. */ .choice-wrap:has(.choice:hover) .bots-switch, .choice-wrap:has(.choice:focus-visible) .bots-switch { transform: translate(-2px, calc(-50% - 2px)); } .bots-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .bots-switch .track { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 34px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #e3d8c2; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); transition: background 0.12s; } .bots-switch .track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 22px; height: 22px; background: var(--ink); transition: left 0.12s; } .bots-switch input:checked + .track { background: var(--green); } .bots-switch input:checked + .track::after { left: 33px; background: var(--paper); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink); } .bots-switch input:focus-visible + .track { outline: 3px dashed var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } /* A notice over the haven home, closed with OK. In the menu's flow it sat behind PLAY and the room code card, half hidden (owner, 2026-10-13). */ #shipped-news { position: fixed; left: 50%; top: 50%; translate: -50% -50%; z-index: 50; width: min(480px, calc(100vw - 32px)); margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } #shipped-news strong { font: 900 18px/1.1 var(--head); } #shipped-news p { margin: 4px 0 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } #shipped-news div { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; font-weight: 800; } #shipped-news button { padding: 6px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: 900 13px var(--head); cursor: pointer; } @media (max-width: 860px) { .gear-grid, .gear:not([data-step='gear']) .gear-grid { /* Stacked, the cards need no common height. */ --menu-h: 96px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: 'stage' 'menu' 'code'; grid-template-rows: auto; } /* Too small a stage for the colours: they sit under the level card (playMenu.ts moves them). */ .gear-grid > .looks { grid-column: 1 / -1; } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .choices.maps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .step:not(.off) { animation: none; } }
/* Players: the two modes and the maps, one panel each, a colour band on top */ .modes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 18px; } .modes .panel { padding: 18px 22px 20px; border-top: 14px solid var(--c); } .modes .panel:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(0.6deg); } .modes h3 { font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .modes p { margin: 0; } .controls { margin-top: 34px; padding: 22px 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 18px 28px; align-items: start; } .controls h3 { font-size: 22px; } .keys { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 22px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .keys li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 700; } kbd { min-width: 34px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 2.5px solid var(--ink); border-bottom-width: 5px; background: #fff; font: 800 14px/1.2 var(--font); text-align: center; } .facts { margin-top: 34px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 26px; } .facts h3 { font-size: 19px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .facts p { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .modes, .facts, .controls { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .modes .panel:nth-child(2) { transform: none; } }
#play { padding-bottom: 56px; } .more { margin-top: 40px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 16px 32px; } .more p { margin: 0; } .tiktok { padding: 12px 16px; border-left: 6px solid var(--ink); background: var(--horizon); }
/* Friends Weekend (weekendHome.ts): a small card under the hero's cards, and the event section. */ .event-row { padding-top: 8px; padding-bottom: 24px; } .event-card { --tilt: -0.8deg; --gold: #ffd23f; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; padding: 14px 26px; min-height: 150px; width: min(100%, 460px); color: var(--gold) !important; text-decoration: none; /* The event section's plum panel with the Ink & Gold pack's gold rays and halftone, so the card and the section it scrolls to read as one thing (owner, 2026-10-09: no black). */ background: radial-gradient(rgba(255, 210, 63, 0.14) 22%, transparent 25%) 0 0 / 12px 12px, repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, rgba(255, 210, 63, 0.08) 0 5deg, transparent 5deg 10deg), #4a3468; } #gear .event-card::after { border-color: rgba(255, 210, 63, 0.7); } .event-text { display: grid; gap: 3px; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .event-card small { font: 900 clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 20px) / 1.2 var(--head); letter-spacing: 2.4px; } .event-card b { font: 900 clamp(28px, 2.8vw, 40px) / 0.95 var(--head); letter-spacing: -0.5px; -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } .event-card em { justify-self: start; padding: 3px 12px; background: var(--gold); color: #15111c; font: 900 18px / 1.2 var(--head); font-style: normal; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; border: 3px solid #15111c; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #0e0b14; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); } .event-card svg { position: relative; z-index: 1; flex: none; /* A blocky gold arrow with the page's ink outline and hard ink shadow, like the title (owner, 2026-10-09). */ width: 58px; height: 68px; overflow: visible; fill: var(--gold); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-linejoin: miter; filter: drop-shadow(4px 4px 0 var(--ink)); animation: event-nudge 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes event-nudge { 50% { transform: translateY(4px); } } /* The whole card drifts a little and slowly, so it catches the eye (owner, 2026-10-09). It uses the separate translate and rotate properties: they add to the card's own tilt and hover lift (transform). */ .event-card { animation: event-drift 7s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes event-drift { 0%, 100% { translate: 0 0; rotate: 0deg; } 30% { translate: 2px -4px; rotate: 0.9deg; } 65% { translate: -2px 2px; rotate: -0.6deg; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .event-card, .event-card svg { animation: none; } } /* The haven: the card stands on the bottom row, in PLAY's row at the far left, where it shows at first sight. */ #gear.haven:not(.phone-mode) .event-row { position: absolute; z-index: 3; left: 2.5%; bottom: var(--haven-lift); width: min(400px, 29.5%); max-width: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } #gear.haven:not(.phone-mode) .event-card { width: 100%; } .gear.haven:not([data-step='gear']) .event-row { display: none; } .event { padding: 72px 0 56px; /* A members' lounge: plum and gold, dearer than the page's yellow (item 201). */ background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 45%, #3d2a57 0%, #1d1429 70%); color: var(--paper); border-top: 3px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; } .event-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.25fr); grid-template-areas: 'intro scene' 'steps scene' 'cta scene' 'fine scene' 'rare scene'; grid-template-rows: auto auto auto auto 1fr; gap: 24px 48px; align-items: start; } .event-intro { grid-area: intro; } .event-steps { grid-area: steps; } .event-make { grid-area: cta; } /* The fine print under the button (owner, 2026-10-09): small and quiet, close under it. */ .event-fine { grid-area: fine; margin: -12px 0 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; color: rgba(255, 247, 230, 0.7); text-wrap: pretty; } .event-rare { grid-area: rare; } .event-intro, .event-steps, .event-make, .event-fine, .event-rare { position: relative; z-index: 1; } /* The scene fills the whole section, behind the text (the phone puts it between the text, below). */ .event-canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.5s; } .event-canvas.drawn { opacity: 1; } .event-kicker { color: #e3b04b; margin: 0 0 6px; font: 900 14px / 1.2 var(--head); letter-spacing: 1.4px; } /* The page's sticker title, like the logo and JOIN THE SQUAD!: capitals, ink outline, hard ink shadow. */ .event-intro h2 { font: 900 clamp(32px, 4.4vw, 52px) / 1 var(--head); letter-spacing: -1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--yellow); -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; text-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); margin-bottom: 14px; } .event-steps { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 14px; } /* The page's own stickers: paper cards with an ink outline and a hard shadow, a little tilted. */ .event-steps li { padding: 14px 18px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink-soft); border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink); display: grid; gap: 2px; font-size: 17px; transform: rotate(-0.6deg); } .event-steps li:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(0.5deg); } .event-steps li b { font: 900 26px / 1.1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.3px; color: var(--ink); } /* The scarcity sticker: smaller, red, at the bottom right of the whole section (the phone keeps it in the flow). */ .event-rare { position: absolute; right: calc((100% - min(var(--max), 100% - 2 * var(--gutter))) / 2); bottom: 30px; justify-self: end; display: grid; gap: 1px; margin: 0; padding: 8px 14px; max-width: 270px; background: var(--red); color: var(--paper); border: 3px solid #15111c; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #0e0b14; transform: rotate(1.5deg); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25; } .event-rare b { font: 900 18px / 1.1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #0e0b14; } /* A plum sticker panel behind the left column so the text reads over the scene: the lounge's own colour, outlined in ink with a hard shadow like the page's other cards (owner: no black panel). */ .event-grid::before { content: ''; grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / -1; align-self: stretch; margin: -28px -28px -28px -32px; background: radial-gradient(rgba(255, 210, 63, 0.09) 22%, transparent 25%) 0 0 / 12px 12px, #4a3468; border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--ink); transform: rotate(-0.5deg); z-index: 0; } /* Haunted Week (owner, 2026-10-23): the panel is pumpkin orange, not the lounge's plum. Near-black text on #e0700f is 5.75:1, AA for the small print. The yellow title would wash out on orange, so it turns near-black with a hard yellow shadow; the yellow date tag stays. The phone has no panel, so there the section itself is orange. Friends Weekend has no data-event, so it keeps its plum. */ .event[data-event='haunted-2026'] .event-grid::before { background: radial-gradient(rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.12) 22%, transparent 25%) 0 0 / 12px 12px, #e0700f; } .event[data-event='haunted-2026'] .event-kicker, .event[data-event='haunted-2026'] .event-fine { color: #15111c; } .event[data-event='haunted-2026'] .event-fine { font-weight: 600; } .event[data-event='haunted-2026'] .event-intro h2 { color: #15111c; -webkit-text-stroke: 0; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #ffd23f; } @media (max-width: 820px) { .event[data-event='haunted-2026'] { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 45%, #e0700f 0%, #d4640c 80%); } } .event-when { display: table; margin: 0 0 20px; padding: 4px 16px; background: #ffd23f; color: #15111c; border: 3px solid #15111c; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #0e0b14; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); font: 900 clamp(20px, 3vw, 28px) / 1.2 var(--head); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; } /* The Ink & Gold pack's colours: dark ink face, gold edge and text. */ .event-make { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 6px; padding: 20px 28px; background: #ffd23f; color: #15111c; border: 4px solid #15111c; /* Heavy and outlined, so it reads as the thing to press: a gold ring, then the hard shadow. */ box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffd23f, 9px 9px 0 3px #0e0b14; font-size: clamp(26px, 3vw, 34px); letter-spacing: 0.5px; transform: rotate(-0.8deg); transition: transform 0.12s; } .event-make:hover { background: #ffe27a; transform: translate(-2px, -3px) rotate(-0.8deg); } .event-make:active { transform: translate(5px, 5px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffd23f, 3px 3px 0 3px #0e0b14; } @media (max-width: 820px) { .event-rare { position: relative; right: auto; bottom: auto; } .event-grid::before { display: none; } .event-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: 'intro' 'scene' 'steps' 'cta' 'fine' 'rare'; } .event-canvas { position: static; z-index: auto; grid-area: scene; height: auto; min-height: 300px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; } } /* A room made from the event section has no Bots switch: its packs need a room without bots (weekendHome.ts). */ .event-room .room-bots { display: none; }
/* landing-ads.css: part of landing.html's styles, linked from it in order (the cascade depends on the order). */ /* Ad sales are off until CONFIG.adsLive: "soon" shows a teaser, "live" the shop. */ [data-ads='soon'] .live-only, [data-ads='live'] .soon-only, [data-ads='soon'] .spot .tag { display: none !important; } [data-ads='soon'] .spot { cursor: default; }
/* ---------- Advertisers: the blue print plate ---------- */ .plate { position: relative; background-color: var(--plate); background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.22) 22%, transparent 25%); background-size: 10px 10px; border-top: 3px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); color: var(--ink); } .plate .sec-head h2 { color: var(--paper); -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; text-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } /* Narration box, as in a comic panel */ .plate .sec-head p { padding: 14px 18px; background: var(--paper); border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } .why { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px; } .why .panel { padding: 22px 24px; } .why h3 { font-size: 22px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .why p { margin: 0; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .why { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
/* Calculator */ .calc { margin-top: 56px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 22px; align-items: start; } .calc-left { display: grid; gap: 22px; } .picker { padding: 22px; } .picker h3, .result h3, .mapbox h3 { font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 4px; } .hint { font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin: 0 0 16px; } .slots { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; } .slot { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px 1fr auto; gap: 4px 12px; align-items: start; padding: 12px 14px; border: 2.5px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .slot input { appearance: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin: 2px 0 0; border: 2.5px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .slot input:checked { background: var(--yellow); } .slot input:checked::after { content: ''; width: 10px; height: 6px; border-left: 3px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-45deg); } .slot:has(input:checked) { background: #fff9e3; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } .slot:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .slot .name { font-weight: 900; font-size: 17px; } .slot .price { font: 800 15px var(--font); white-space: nowrap; } .slot .what { grid-column: 2 / 4; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-soft); line-height: 1.4; } .tower-note { margin: 14px 0 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
.mapbox { padding: 22px; } .yardmap { width: 100%; max-width: 460px; margin: 8px auto 0; } .yardmap .t { font: 800 2.3px var(--head); fill: var(--ink); } .yardmap .m { fill: #fff; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 0.5; stroke-dasharray: 1.2 0.8; transition: fill 0.15s; } .yardmap .on .m { fill: var(--yellow); stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-width: 0.7; } .yardmap .hl .m { fill: var(--red); }
.result { padding: 24px; position: sticky; top: 84px; } .ctl { margin: 18px 0 0; } .ctl-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 8px; } .stepper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .stepper button { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: 900 22px/1 var(--head); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); flex: none; } .stepper button:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } input[type='range'] { flex: 1; min-width: 0; accent-color: var(--ink); height: 28px; } .seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; } .seg label { position: relative; padding: 8px 6px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.2; } .seg label + label { border-left: 3px solid var(--ink); } .seg input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .seg label:has(input:checked) { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .seg label:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow); outline-offset: -6px; } .seg small { display: block; font: 600 12px var(--font); opacity: 0.8; } .scenario-note { min-height: 2.6em; margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-soft); } .big-out { margin: 20px 0 6px; padding: 18px 18px 16px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); } .big-out .n { font: 900 clamp(40px, 5vw, 56px) / 1 var(--font); letter-spacing: -2px; } .big-out .l { font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; } .outs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin: 10px 0 0; } .outs div { padding: 10px 12px; border: 2.5px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; } .outs dt { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-soft); } .outs dd { margin: 2px 0 0; font: 800 21px var(--font); } .bill { margin: 18px 0 0; border-top: 3px solid var(--ink); padding-top: 12px; } .bill-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 3px 0; font-size: 15px; } .bill-row span:last-child { font-family: var(--font); font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .bill-row.off span:last-child { color: #b3261e; } .bill-row.total { margin-top: 6px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 2px dashed var(--ink); font-weight: 900; font-size: 20px; } .bill-row.total span:last-child { font-weight: 900; } .compare { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-soft); } .chart { margin: 18px 0 0; position: relative; } .chart h4 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 15px; } .chart svg { width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; } .chart .axis { font: 600 11px var(--font); fill: var(--ink-soft); } .chart .bar { fill: var(--blue); } .chart .hit:hover + .bar, .chart .bar.on { fill: var(--ink); } .tip { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; padding: 6px 10px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 700 13px var(--font); white-space: nowrap; transform: translate(-50%, -100%); opacity: 0; } .tip.show { opacity: 1; } .book { margin-top: 20px; width: 100%; } .book-note { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 13px; text-align: center; color: var(--ink-soft); } .empty { padding: 18px; border: 3px dashed var(--ink); font-weight: 700; margin-top: 20px; } @media (max-width: 980px) { .calc { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .result { position: static; } }
/* Founding offer: one starburst sticker */ .burst { position: absolute; right: max(var(--gutter), calc((100% - var(--max)) / 2)); top: -48px; width: 150px; height: 150px; display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; font: 900 17px/1.1 var(--head); transform: rotate(8deg); } .burst svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .burst span { position: relative; width: 96px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .burst { position: relative; right: auto; top: auto; margin: -20px var(--gutter) 10px auto; width: 128px; height: 128px; font-size: 15px; } }
/* Preview */ .preview { margin-top: 56px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.4fr); gap: 22px; } .preview .panel { padding: 22px 24px; } .preview h3 { font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .field { display: grid; gap: 6px; margin: 16px 0 0; font-weight: 800; } .field input[type='text'] { padding: 10px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; font: 700 17px var(--head); color: var(--ink); } .file { position: relative; } .file input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; } .file:has(input:focus-visible) .btn { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .swatches { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .swatches label { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); cursor: pointer; position: relative; } .swatches input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .swatches label:has(input:checked) { box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); transform: translate(-2px, -2px); outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: -7px; } .swatches label:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .preview-stage { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--sky), var(--horizon) 70%); } .preview-stage .t { font-family: var(--head); font-weight: 900; } .privacy-line { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-soft); } @media (max-width: 900px) { .preview { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
/* Booking steps, rules, FAQ */ .steps { margin: 56px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 14px; counter-reset: book; } .steps li { padding: 18px; background: var(--paper); border: 3px solid var(--ink); font-size: 15px; } .steps strong { display: block; font-size: 17px; margin-bottom: 4px; } .steps strong::before { counter-increment: book; content: counter(book) '. '; } @media (max-width: 980px) { .steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } } @media (max-width: 520px) { .steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } .after { background: var(--horizon); } .rules { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 18px; } .rules .panel { padding: 20px 22px; } .rules h3 { font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .rules h3 i { width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); flex: none; } .rules ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; } .rules li { margin: 4px 0; } .art-rules { margin-top: 18px; padding: 18px 22px; border: 3px dashed var(--ink); } .art-rules p { margin: 0; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .rules { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } .faq { margin-top: 64px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px 22px; align-items: start; } .faq h2 { grid-column: 1 / -1; font: 900 clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 40px) / 1.05 var(--head); letter-spacing: -1px; margin-bottom: 12px; } details { border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; } summary { padding: 14px 18px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } summary::after { content: '+'; font: 900 22px/1 var(--head); } details[open] summary::after { content: '–'; } details[open] { box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } details p { padding: 0 18px; font-size: 16px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .faq { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } .final { margin-top: 64px; padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 40px); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 20px 40px; align-items: center; background: var(--yellow); border: 4px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 var(--ink); } .final h2 { font: 900 clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 42px) / 1.05 var(--head); letter-spacing: -1px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .final p { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .final { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto; } .cloud, .blimp { animation: none; } .spot .tag { transition: none; } }
/* The Creator panel inside the Locker (client/src/lockerCreator.ts, creator-packs.md, item 564): a button under the packs row; its panel takes the place of the tile grid. */ .locker-creator-row { padding: 8px 14px; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fffbe9; } .locker-creator-row .btn { width: 100%; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; } .locker.creator .locker-grid, .locker.creator .locker-tabs { display: none; font-weight: 600; } .cr-code { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; } .cr-code code { padding: 3px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); font: 900 20px/1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.15em; } .cr-code .btn { padding: 3px 12px; font-size: 12px; } .cr-tier { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font: 700 14px/1.3 var(--head); } .cr-tier i { color: var(--green); /* The match select on the haven. The friends room hides the stickman and takes the middle of the page, tall map cards in one row (item 307, owner pick 2026-10-14: draft C). "Ready?" keeps the room and lays its buttons out like step 1 (item 415). Phones reset these in landing-touch.css. Design: docs/design/play-menu-steps.md, "307", and play-menu.md, "415". */
/* The stickman steps out of the friends room only; after PLAY he stays (item 415, owner 2026-10-14). */ #gear.haven[data-step='invite'] #gear-canvas { visibility: hidden; } #gear.haven[data-step='invite'] .gear-grid { align-content: center; padding-bottom: 24px; }
/* "Ready?" (item 571, owner pick A, 2026-10-17; before: item 415): the room and the stickman stay. Three mode tiles stand in a row over the floor, PICK A MODE above them, QUICK JOIN a slim line under them, BACK a small arrow card at their left. The pink WITH FRIENDS card (the room code, landing-cards.css) stands at the right. Each piece is placed against the section, as PLAY is, so the card and the steps around them take no room of their own. Phones: landing-touch.css. */ #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch'])[data-step='start'] :is(.gear-card, .menu-steps) { position: static; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start:not(.off) { position: static; display: block; animation: none; --row-w: min(680px, 47%); --quick-h: 58px; --tiles-h: 204px; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start :is(.choice.quick, .mode-tiles, .back, .pick-label) { position: absolute; z-index: 3; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .choice.quick { bottom: var(--haven-lift); left: 50%; width: var(--row-w); min-height: 0; height: var(--quick-h); translate: -50% 0; display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; padding: 0 20px; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .choice.quick b { font-size: 22px; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .choice.quick > span { font-size: 14px; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .mode-tiles { bottom: calc(var(--haven-lift) + var(--quick-h) + 18px); left: 50%; width: var(--row-w); min-height: 0; height: var(--tiles-h); gap: 20px; translate: -50% 0; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .choice.mode-tile { min-height: 0; height: 100%; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .pick-label { bottom: calc(var(--haven-lift) + var(--quick-h) + 18px + var(--tiles-h) + 12px); left: calc(50% - var(--row-w) / 2); } /* BACK: a small arrow card at the tiles' left, at the bottom of the row. */ #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .back { bottom: var(--haven-lift); left: calc(50% - var(--row-w) / 2 - 24px - 64px); width: 64px; height: 64px; min-height: 0; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .back span { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
/* The friends room: the map cards stand tall in one row (a square picture over the name, the thumbnails' own shape; taller pushed PLAY below the fold at 900 px). */ #gear.haven[data-step='invite'] .gear-card { width: min(1240px, 90vw); } #gear.haven #room-maps .map-pick img { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; object-fit: cover; } /* Five mode tiles (item 752): a row wider than QUICK JOIN, so a name fits its card and the one-line hint shows (the 112 px square tiles of three modes cut "DEATHMATCH" and hid the hints). */ html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start:not(.off) { --tiles-h: 156px; } #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .mode-tiles { width: min(980px, 72%); gap: 16px; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .mode-tile { align-content: start; padding: 12px 10px; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .mode-tile .tile-blurb { display: block; font-size: 13px; } html #gear.haven:not([data-layout='touch']) #step-start .mode-tile .tile-name { font-size: clamp(15px, 1.15vw, 20px); letter-spacing: 0; }
/* landing-touch.css: part of landing.html's styles, linked last (the cascade depends on the order). /* The top bar (outside #gear, so under html.touch-menu): one line, as on a narrow phone in portrait, whichever way it is held: logo, Discord and Feedback as icons, PLAY. #gear.touch-menu { --stage-h: min(44svh, 112vw); --touch-gap: 18px; background: #4a2616; } /* The room on top, the width of the screen. */ #gear.touch-menu .gear-stage { inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: var(--stage-h); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); } #gear.touch-menu .gear-grid { display: block; min-height: 0; padding: calc(var(--stage-h) - 34px) 0 0; } #gear.touch-menu .touch-col { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; gap: var(--touch-gap); padding: 0 0 72px; } /* The cards stop floating: each takes the column's width. */ #gear.touch-menu .touch-col > *, #gear.touch-menu .touch-col .haven-float { position: relative; inset: auto; translate: none; width: auto; min-height: 0; margin: 0; } /* Name and level side by side, hanging over the stage's bottom edge. */ #gear.touch-menu .haven-toprow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; --top-card-w: auto; } #gear.touch-menu .who-card, #gear.touch-menu .level-stripe { padding: 12px 14px; } #gear.touch-menu .who-card .gear-who b { font-size: 19px; } /* 16 px or more: iPhone zooms the page into a smaller field when it gets focus. */ #gear.touch-menu input { font-size: 17px; } #gear.touch-menu .level-stripe .xp { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 8px; } #gear.touch-menu .level-stripe .xp-bar { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; } #gear.touch-menu .level-stripe .xp-lv.next { justify-self: end; } #gear.touch-menu .play-big { min-height: 104px; font-size: 60px; } /* The room code: the field and JOIN on one line, CREATE A ROOM under them. */ #gear.touch-menu .code-card { padding: 16px 18px 14px; } #gear.touch-menu .code-card h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 17px; } #gear.touch-menu .code-join { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; } #gear.touch-menu #code-create { grid-column: 1 / -1; } #gear.touch-menu .code-join .btn { min-height: 48px; } /* The Locker column becomes one row of three buttons: LOCKER, PACKS and SIGN IN (item 571). inset: auto; z-index: auto; width: auto; max-width: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } #gear.touch-menu.haven .touch-col .event-card { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 0; padding: 12px 20px; box-sizing: border-box; miniBoard.ts writes the line count, 0 without the board); --tl-fps and --tl-ping are the * counter's and the chip's slots while they show. */ :root { /* The minimap (minimapView.ts, game-minimap.css) is first in the stack; } html:has(#fps:not([hidden])) { --tl-fps: 32px; } html:has(#ping-note:not([hidden])) { --tl-ping: 32px; } .mini-board { padding: 3px 0; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.62); color: var(--paper); font: 800 13px/19px var(--head); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.5); } .mini-board:empty { display: none; } .mini-board div { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 0 7px; } .mini-board div.me { background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); } .mini-board i { min-width: 1.2em; font-style: normal; opacity: 0.75; } .mini-board span { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .mini-board b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } #mini-board { left: 12px; top: calc((12px + var(--tl-map)) / var(--hud-scale, 1)); min-width: 150px; max-width: 200px; zoom: var(--hud-scale, 1); } /* The browser draws on the CPU (item 295, gpuCard.ts), or a slow desktop (item 249, lowFpsCard.ts): a card top left, at the bottom of the corner's stack; only its link and buttons take clicks. */ #gpu-card, #fps-card { left: 14px; top: calc((12px + var(--tl-shift) + var(--tl-fps, 0px) + var(--tl-ping, 0px)) / var(--hud-scale, 1)); width: min(300px, calc(100vw - 28px)); padding: 12px 16px 10px; background: var(--paper); border: 4px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--ink); transform: rotate(-1deg); zoom: var(--hud-scale, 1); } #gpu-card h2, #fps-card h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 900 22px var(--head); color: var(--red); -webkit-text-stroke: 1.5px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; } #gpu-card p, #fps-card p { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 800 13px/1.35 var(--head); } #gpu-card a, #gpu-card button, #fps-card button { display: inline-block; margin: 0 6px 0 0; padding: 4px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); font: 900 13px var(--head); text-decoration: none; pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer; } #gpu-card button.ghost, #fps-card button.ghost { background: var(--paper); } #gpu-card small, #fps-card small { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font: 700 11px var(--font); } #killfeed { right: 14px; top: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 6px; } /* Kill feed: light names on a dark panel, whatever the sky; the player colour is a dot. */ .kf { display: flex; align-items: center; max-width: min(460px, calc(100vw / var(--hud-scale, 1) - 28px)); padding: 3px 10px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); border: 2px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.5); white-space: nowrap; transition: opacity 0.5s; } .kf.me { color: var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); } .kf .gun { margin: 0 6px; } /* Someone joined a friends room: smaller and lighter than a kill. */ .kf.join { gap: 5px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); } .kf-name { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; max-width: 150px; } .kf-name span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } /* Your own kill or death: ink on yellow, never a team colour on yellow. */ .kf.me .kf-name { color: inherit !important; } .kf-how { display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin: 0 8px; } .kf-head { color: var(--red); } .kf-dist { flex: none; margin-left: 8px; font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.8; } /* Narrow screens: the feed would cover the timer at the top centre, so it starts below it. */ @media (max-width: 720px) { #killfeed { top: 78px; } } /* The gun-game leader's crown, beside a name or in the top bar. */ .crown-ico { color: #f6b21b; margin: 0 4px; vertical-align: -2px; } /* "bot" after a bot's name: quiet, not a badge. */ .bot { margin-left: 5px; font: 600 0.75em var(--font); opacity: 0.6; -webkit-text-stroke: 0; }
/* Bottom right: ammo. */ #vitals { right: 18px; bottom: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-width: 150px; } /* Bottom left: health as a number beside a bar that drains towards the left. */ #health { left: 18px; bottom: 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 220px; padding: 3px 8px 3px 10px; } #health .num { min-width: 3ch; font: 900 22px var(--head); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } #health .track { flex: 1; height: 16px; background: rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.18); } #health .fill { height: 100%; background: var(--green); transition: width 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } #health.mid .fill { background: var(--orange); } #health.low .fill { background: var(--red); } /* The ammo card (ammoCard.ts, item 168): always the same size. The slots on top, the gun in hand with its count, one bar per round. */ .ammo-row { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; } #ammo { width: 260px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; } #ammo .slots { display: flex; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); } #ammo .sl { flex: 1; height: 26px; min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1px; border-right: 2px solid var(--ink); opacity: 0.7; } #ammo .sl:last-child { border-right: 0; } #ammo .sl img { height: 13px; max-width: 34px; object-fit: contain; } #ammo .sl.on { background: var(--yellow); opacity: 1; } #ammo .sl.faint { opacity: 0.3; } #ammo .body { padding: 6px 10px 8px; } #ammo .hd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 34px; } #ammo .hd.melee img { order: 3; } #ammo .hd.melee .num { display: none; } #ammo .hd img { height: 26px; max-width: 110px; object-fit: contain; } #ammo .hd.melee img { height: 30px; } #ammo .label { margin-right: auto; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; } #ammo.empty .label { color: var(--red); } #ammo .num { font: 900 28px var(--head); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } #ammo .bars { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 14px; margin-top: 6px; } #ammo .bars i { flex: 1; background: var(--ink); } #ammo .bars i.x { background: rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.18); } /* Under the ammo, on every gun with a choice of sights: a standing reminder of the T key. */ #sightkey { margin-bottom: -4px; font: 800 14px var(--head); text-align: right; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 3px var(--ink), 0 1px 2px var(--ink); } #sightkey kbd { margin: 0 1px; padding: 0 4px; color: var(--ink); text-shadow: none; } /* "T changes the sight" over the ammo panel (sightHint.ts): the gun's sights, the one on it in yellow. */ #sighthint { padding: 6px 10px 8px; background: var(--paper); transform: rotate(-1.5deg); animation: sighthint 0.35s ease-out; } #sighthint .head { margin-bottom: 6px; font: 900 15px var(--head); text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } #sighthint .row { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; } #sighthint .chip { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px 5px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: #fffdf5; font: 800 9px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.5px; white-space: nowrap; } #sighthint .chip.on { background: var(--yellow); } #sighthint svg { width: 28px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linejoin: round; } #sighthint svg .dot { fill: #ff2a4d; stroke: none; } @keyframes sighthint { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(30px) rotate(-1.5deg); } } /* Gun game: the ladder of guns, over the ammo */ #ladder { right: 18px; bottom: 138px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; text-align: right; } #ladder .done { opacity: 0.45; } #ladder .now { padding: 0 4px; background: var(--yellow); } #ladder .to { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 10px; } #prompt { left: 50%; top: calc(50% + 76px); transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-2deg); padding: 4px 12px; background: var(--paper); border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 15px var(--head); white-space: nowrap; } /* The range's stat line for the gun on the rack. */ #prompt small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font: 700 11px var(--head); } #prompt kbd { display: inline-block; margin-right: 6px; padding: 0 6px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); font: inherit; } #holdring { left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 64px; height: 64px; margin: -32px 0 0 -32px; transform: rotate(-90deg); } #holdring circle { fill: none; stroke-width: 7; } #holdring .track { stroke: rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.45); } #holdring .fill { stroke: var(--yellow); stroke-dasharray: 100; stroke-linecap: round; } #toast { right: 18px; bottom: 148px; padding: 4px 12px; background: var(--yellow); border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 18px var(--head); opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(0.6); } #toast.show { animation: toast 1.6s ease-out; } @keyframes toast { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(0.6); } 12% { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(1.15); } 22% { transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(1); } 80% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(1); } }
/* The big moments (bigMoments.ts; owner, 2026-10-11): a kill streak or a finished daily challenge, big in the upper middle, one at a time for 2.4 s. */ #callout { left: 50%; top: 26%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--yellow); -webkit-text-stroke: 6px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; opacity: 0; } #callout small { display: block; font: 900 20px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #fff; -webkit-text-stroke: 5px var(--ink); } #callout b { display: block; font: 900 68px/1.05 var(--head); } #callout em { display: inline-block; margin-top: 10px; padding: 4px 14px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); color: var(--ink); font: 900 18px var(--head); font-style: normal; -webkit-text-stroke: 0; } #callout.streak b { color: var(--orange); } /* A challenge's words are longer than a streak's: smaller, and white like a stamp. */ #callout.daily b, #callout.lucky b { font-size: 42px; color: #fff; } #callout.daily small, #callout.lucky small { color: var(--green); } #callout.lucky em { background: var(--yellow); } #callout.show { animation: callout 2.4s ease-out both; } @keyframes callout { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.8) rotate(-4deg); } 10% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.92) rotate(1deg); } 18% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1) rotate(-1deg); } 85% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1) rotate(-1deg); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -58%) scale(1) rotate(-1deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #callout.show { animation: callout-still 2.4s both; } } @keyframes callout-still { 0%, 85% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
/* The daily challenges in a match (dailyCard.ts, GameDaily; daily.css; owner, 2026-10-11): top right over the kill feed, only while the scoreboard (Tab) or the pause card (Esc) shows, and only where it fits beside a 560 px card. */ #game-daily { position: fixed; top: 12px; right: 14px; width: min(300px, calc((100vw - 620px) / 2)); box-sizing: border-box; border: 4px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--ink); pointer-events: none; display: none; } body:has(#scoreboard:not([hidden])) #game-daily:not([hidden]), body:has(#pause:not([hidden])):not(:has(#pause-settings:not([hidden]), .pause-view:not([hidden]))) #game-daily:not([hidden]) { display: grid; } /* A phone or a small window: no room beside the card, and the results screen lists the challenges. */ @media (max-width: 1019px) { #game-daily { display: none !important; } }
/* Which team am I on (teamCue.ts, item 385): an edge on the health bar, a label above it, a banner at spawn. */ #health.teamed { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--team); } #teamlabel { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 100%; margin-bottom: 4px; font: 900 13px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--team); -webkit-text-stroke: 3px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; } #teamcue { left: 50%; top: 22%; transform: translateX(-50%); font: 900 54px var(--head); color: var(--team); -webkit-text-stroke: 8px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } #teamcue.show { animation: teamcue 2s ease-out; } @keyframes teamcue { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.5); } 12% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); } 75% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
/* A calmer first hour (item 377): <html data-fh> lists the steps still closed (client/src/firstHour.ts). */ html[data-fh~='daily'] #game-daily { display: none !important; } /* One line about another player's drop (dropTicker.ts): small, top centre, on screen a few seconds. */ .drop-line { position: fixed; top: 54px; left: 50%; z-index: 6; max-width: min(80vw, 520px); padding: 3px 12px; background: var(--yellow); border: 2px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 14px var(--head); pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px); transition: opacity 0.25s, transform 0.25s; } .drop-line.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%); } /* The Haunted Crate's mark (crate.ts): a ghost-green gem with the distance, top of the screen, sliding to where the crate is. */ .crate-mark { position: fixed; top: 84px; left: 50%; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; font: 900 13px var(--head); color: #d9fff0; text-shadow: -1px -1px 0 var(--ink), 1px 1px 0 var(--ink), 1px -1px 0 var(--ink), -1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } .crate-mark[hidden] { display: none; } .crate-mark .gem { width: 16px; height: 16px; background: #a8ffd8; border: 2px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0 10px #a8ffd8; transform: rotate(45deg); } .crate-mark[data-arrow='left'] .gem { border-radius: 50% 0 50% 50%; } .crate-mark[data-arrow='right'] .gem { border-radius: 0 50% 50% 50%; }
/* ==== game-minimap.css ==== */ /* game-minimap.css: the small map top left (minimapView.ts, docs/design/minimap.md). It stands first in the corner's stack; its height goes to --minimap-h, and game-hud.css moves the board, the counters and the cards under it. */ .minimap { left: 12px; top: calc(12px / var(--hud-scale, 1)); box-sizing: content-box; border: 2px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.5); zoom: var(--hud-scale, 1); } /* Hold Tab: the whole map grows in place, over the stack under it, left of the scoreboard (minimapView.ts, place). */ .minimap.whole { z-index: 4; }
/* ==== game-ctf.css ==== */ /* Capture the Flag on the game page (ctfClient.ts, item 747): a strip with both flags' state under the top bar, a line for the flag you carry or lost, and a mark for each flag on the top of the screen. --flag is the team colour, set by the script. */ .ctf-strip { position: fixed; top: 52px; left: 50%; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; font: 900 12px var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: -1px -1px 0 var(--ink), 1px 1px 0 var(--ink), 1px -1px 0 var(--ink), -1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } .ctf-strip[hidden], .ctf-line[hidden], .ctf-mark[hidden] { display: none; } .ctf-flags { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ctf-flag { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 80px; padding: 1px 6px 1px 5px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: rgba(30, 24, 44, 0.72); } .ctf-flag i { width: 12px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--flag); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 62%, 50% 100%, 0 62%); } /* At home, the cloth says it all: the word shows only when a flag is taken or dropped (item 790). */ .ctf-flag[data-status='0'] { min-width: 0; } .ctf-flag[data-status='0'] span { display: none; } /* Taken: the cloth pulses. Dropped: it turns amber. */ .ctf-flag[data-status='1'] i { animation: ctf-pulse 0.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .ctf-flag[data-status='2'] { border-color: #ffb43a; } .ctf-line { padding: 2px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); text-shadow: none; } .ctf-mark { position: fixed; top: 88px; left: 50%; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; font: 900 12px var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: -1px -1px 0 var(--ink), 1px 1px 0 var(--ink), 1px -1px 0 var(--ink), -1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } .ctf-mark .gem { width: 14px; height: 18px; background: var(--flag); border: 2px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--flag); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 62%, 50% 100%, 0 62%); } .ctf-mark[data-carried='1'] .gem { animation: ctf-pulse 0.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .ctf-mark[data-arrow='left'] .gem { transform: rotate(90deg); } .ctf-mark[data-arrow='right'] .gem { transform: rotate(-90deg); } @keyframes ctf-pulse { from { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 0.45; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ctf-flag[data-status='1'] i, .ctf-mark[data-carried='1'] .gem { animation: none; } }
/* ==== game-bomb.css ==== */ /* Pumpkin Bomb on the game page (bombClient.ts, item 749): a strip under the top bar (teamBar.ts) with a line that says what to do for a few seconds, and the plant and defuse bar; a small mark for each site and for the pumpkin under the bar. */ .bomb-strip { position: fixed; top: 52px; left: 50%; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; font: 900 12px var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: -1px -1px 0 var(--ink), 1px 1px 0 var(--ink), 1px -1px 0 var(--ink), -1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } .bomb-strip[hidden], .bomb-line[hidden], .bomb-bar[hidden], .bomb-mark[hidden] { display: none; } .bomb-line { padding: 2px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); text-shadow: none; } .bomb-bar { position: relative; width: 220px; height: 22px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: rgba(30, 24, 44, 0.78); } .bomb-bar i { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 0; background: #ff7a1a; } .bomb-bar[data-kind='defuse'] i { background: #5fd48a; } .bomb-bar span { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; letter-spacing: 1px; } .bomb-mark { position: fixed; top: 88px; left: 50%; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; font: 900 12px var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: -1px -1px 0 var(--ink), 1px 1px 0 var(--ink), 1px -1px 0 var(--ink), -1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } .bomb-mark .gem { display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: #f08a24; color: var(--ink); font-size: 11px; text-shadow: none; } .bomb-mark[data-kind='pumpkin'] .gem { min-width: 14px; height: 14px; background: #ffb43a; } .bomb-mark[data-lit='1'] .gem { box-shadow: 0 0 10px #ffd84a; animation: bomb-pulse 0.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .bomb-mark[data-arrow='left'] { left: 8% !important; } .bomb-mark[data-arrow='right'] { left: 92% !important; } @keyframes bomb-pulse { from { transform: scale(1); } to { transform: scale(1.18); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #team-bar .tb-clock[data-tone='last'], .bomb-mark[data-lit='1'] .gem { animation: none; } } /* The banner (PLANTED, the round, the result) sits under the strip, not over the site marks at the top. */ body:has(.bomb-strip:not([hidden])) #banner { top: calc(140px / var(--hud-scale, 1)); }
/* The top bar of Pumpkin Bomb and Capture the Flag (teamBar.ts, items 767 and 801), as Counter-Strike's: the clock in the middle, each team's score and heads on its side, your team on the left. */ #team-bar { position: fixed; top: 6px; left: 50%; z-index: 4; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: start; gap: 4px; width: min(640px, 96vw); transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; zoom: var(--hud-scale, 1); } #team-bar[hidden] { display: none; } #team-bar .tb-side { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; } #team-bar .tb-side:first-child { justify-content: flex-end; } #team-bar .tb-heads { display: flex; gap: 2px; } #team-bar .tb-head { position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: rgba(30, 24, 44, 0.72); } #team-bar [data-team='0'] .tb-head { border-bottom: 4px solid #2f7dff; } #team-bar [data-team='1'] .tb-head { border-bottom: 4px solid #e8343a; } #team-bar .tb-head img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; } #team-bar .tb-head[data-dead='1'] img { filter: grayscale(1) brightness(0.55); } #team-bar .tb-head[data-dead='1'] { border-bottom-color: #777; } #team-bar .tb-head[data-dead='1']::after { content: '×'; position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 900 30px/1 var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 3px var(--ink), 1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } #team-bar .tb-head[data-carrier='1'] { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow); } /* Your own head is ringed in white. */ #team-bar .tb-head[data-self='1'] { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 1px; } #team-bar .tb-heads i { align-self: center; font: 900 12px var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } /* The team's score: a block of its colour next to the clock. */ #team-bar .tb-score { display: grid; place-items: center; box-sizing: border-box; min-width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0 6px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); font: 900 26px/1 var(--head); text-align: center; color: #fff; text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } #team-bar [data-team='0'] .tb-score { background: #2f7dff; } #team-bar [data-team='1'] .tb-score { background: #e8343a; } /* The count of the living: shown on a phone, where the heads would be too small (game-touch.css). */ #team-bar .tb-alive { display: none; font: 900 12px var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } #team-bar .tb-mid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; box-sizing: border-box; min-width: 104px; height: 38px; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: rgba(30, 24, 44, 0.78); font: 900 9px var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } #team-bar .tb-mid small { font: inherit; letter-spacing: 0.5px; white-space: nowrap; } #team-bar .tb-clock { font: 900 22px/1 var(--head); color: var(--yellow); } /* The pumpkin is planted: the fuse is orange, and red in its last seconds. A round is won: the winner's colour. */ #team-bar .tb-clock[data-tone='fuse'] { color: #ff7a1a; } #team-bar .tb-clock[data-tone='last'] { color: #ff4a3a; animation: bomb-pulse 0.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } #team-bar .tb-clock[data-tone='win0'] { color: #6fa4ff; } #team-bar .tb-clock[data-tone='win1'] { color: #ff6a6f; }
/* The pumpkin in the hands (bombHand.ts, item 768): the fifth slot of the ammo card, and the plant prompt over the crosshair. */ #ammo .sl { border-right: 0; } #ammo .sl:has(~ .sl:not([hidden])) { border-right: 2px solid var(--ink); } #ammo .sl[hidden] { display: none; } #ammo .sl[data-kind='pumpkin']::before { content: ''; width: 18px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50% 50% 46% 46%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, #ffb04a, #f08a24 60%, #c4600e); } .bomb-plant { position: fixed; top: 58%; left: 50%; z-index: 5; padding: 4px 16px; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); font: 900 22px var(--head); } .bomb-plant[hidden] { display: none; }
/* The carry icon (bombCarryIcon.ts, item 789): a pumpkin on the right while this player carries it. */ .bomb-carry { position: fixed; top: 50%; right: 14px; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; transform: translateY(-50%); pointer-events: none; font: 900 10px var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: -1px -1px 0 var(--ink), 1px 1px 0 var(--ink), 1px -1px 0 var(--ink), -1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } .bomb-carry[hidden] { display: none; }
/* ==== game-hardpoint.css ==== */ /* Hardpoint on the game page (hardpointClient.ts, item 287): the A B C bar under the top bar, a line for what you do on a point, and a mark for each point on the top of the screen. --own is the colour of the team that holds the point, --fill the colour of the side the capture leads for, --amount how far the capture has gone. Set by the script. */ .hp-strip { position: fixed; top: 52px; left: 50%; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; font: 900 12px var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: -1px -1px 0 var(--ink), 1px 1px 0 var(--ink), 1px -1px 0 var(--ink), -1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } .hp-strip[hidden], .hp-line[hidden], .hp-mark[hidden] { display: none; } .hp-points { display: flex; gap: 6px; } /* One point: a box with the letter in the holder's colour, and a bar under it that fills with the capture. */ .hp-point { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 38px; height: 34px; overflow: hidden; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: rgba(30, 24, 44, 0.72); } .hp-point b { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-size: 18px; color: var(--own); } .hp-point[data-owner='-1'] b { color: #fff; } .hp-point i { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: var(--amount); height: 7px; background: var(--fill); border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); transition: width 0.12s linear; } /* A point that is taken pulses; a contested one blinks amber. */ .hp-point[data-status='capturing'] i { animation: hp-pulse 0.7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .hp-point[data-status='contested'] { border-color: #ffb43a; animation: hp-pulse 0.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .hp-line { padding: 2px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); text-shadow: none; } .hp-mark { position: fixed; /* Under the line, which shows below the A B C bar. */ top: 120px; left: 50%; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; font: 900 12px var(--head); color: #fff; text-shadow: -1px -1px 0 var(--ink), 1px 1px 0 var(--ink), 1px -1px 0 var(--ink), -1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } .hp-mark .gem { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 3px solid var(--own); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(30, 24, 44, 0.72); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink); font-size: 12px; } .hp-mark[data-status='contested'] .gem, .hp-mark[data-status='capturing'] .gem { animation: hp-pulse 0.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .hp-mark[data-arrow='left'] .gem { border-left-width: 7px; } .hp-mark[data-arrow='right'] .gem { border-right-width: 7px; } @keyframes hp-pulse { from { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 0.5; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .hp-point[data-status='capturing'] i, .hp-point[data-status='contested'], .hp-mark .gem { animation: none; } } /* A phone is short: the bar shrinks and the marks sit a little higher. */ @media (max-height: 460px) { .hp-point { width: 30px; height: 26px; } .hp-point b { font-size: 14px; } .hp-mark { top: 104px; } }
/* ==== game-chat.css ==== */ /* game-chat.css: the room chat (client/src/chatView.ts, docs/design/trust-and-safety.md, "129"). Linked from index.html. */ #chat { left: 14px; bottom: 190px; width: min(420px, calc(100vw / var(--hud-scale, 1) - 28px)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; pointer-events: none; } #chat[hidden] { display: none; } #chat .chat-lines { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } /* Light text on a dark panel, whatever the sky; the writer's name is in the team colour. */ #chat .chat-line { margin: 0; padding: 2px 8px; align-self: flex-start; max-width: 100%; background: rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.62); color: #fff; font: 700 13px/1.3 var(--font); overflow-wrap: anywhere; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); } #chat .chat-line b { font-weight: 800; } #chat .chat-notice { color: #bfb8c9; font-style: italic; } #chat .chat-input { pointer-events: auto; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 6px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 700 14px var(--font); } #chat .chat-input[hidden] { display: none; } #chat .chat-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; } #chat .chat-row[hidden] { display: none; } #chat .chat-row .chat-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; width: auto; } /* "Chat: press [Enter]" under the lines (chatHint.ts): see-through, so it never covers the fight. Its text is as big as the chat input's (14px), the owner's ask of 2026-10-15; chatHint.test.ts holds the two equal. */ #chat .chat-hint { align-self: flex-start; padding: 2px 8px; background: rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.22); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62); font: 700 14px/1.3 var(--font); text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); } #chat .chat-hint[hidden] { display: none; } #chat .chat-hint kbd { margin-left: 2px; font: 800 14px/1.3 var(--font); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); } /* SEND and CHAT are for touch: game-touch.css shows them under html.touch. */ #chat .chat-send, .chat-open { display: none; }
/* ==== game-menu.css ==== */ /* game-menu.css: part of index.html's styles, linked from it in order (the cascade depends on the order). */ #pause { position: fixed; min-width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 32px)); z-index: 5; } #pause label { display: block; margin: 10px 0; font-weight: 800; } #pause label[hidden] { display: none; } /* Slider rows: the name on the left, the slider, then the value on the right. On a phone the slider moves under the name and the value. */ #pause .slide { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 168px 1fr 92px; grid-template-areas: 'name range value'; align-items: center; column-gap: 14px; margin: 6px 0; } #pause .slide .name { grid-area: name; } #pause .slide input[type='range'] { grid-area: range; } #pause .slide output, #pause .slide .custom { grid-area: value; justify-self: end; text-align: right; } @media (max-width: 560px) { #pause .slide { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; grid-template-areas: 'name value' 'range range'; margin: 10px 0; } } /* Sensitivities: the value is a field for a custom number, typed to a thousandth (settings.ts). */ #pause .custom small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.7; white-space: nowrap; } #pause input.typed { box-sizing: border-box; width: 92px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 17px; text-align: right; -moz-appearance: textfield; } #pause input.typed::-webkit-inner-spin-button, #pause input.typed::-webkit-outer-spin-button { -webkit-appearance: none; margin: 0; } #pause input.typed:focus { outline: none; background: var(--yellow); } /* Sliders: a fat ink-lined groove that fills red up to a yellow knob big enough for a finger. `--fill` comes from settings.ts. */ #pause input[type='range'] { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; display: block; width: 100%; height: 40px; margin: 2px 0 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; } #pause input[type='range']::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 22px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--red) var(--fill, 50%), #fff var(--fill, 50%)); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); } #pause input[type='range']::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 34px; height: 34px; margin-top: -9px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); transition: transform 0.1s; } #pause input[type='range']:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform: scale(1.15); } #pause input[type='range']::-moz-range-track { height: 16px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); } #pause input[type='range']::-moz-range-progress { height: 16px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--red); } #pause input[type='range']::-moz-range-thumb { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); } #pause input[type='range']:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } /* On/off settings, at the top of the settings: a grid of rows with no box, each a drawing, a short label and its switch. The long explanation is the row's tooltip. Keybindings (.set-link) is a row too, with an arrow where a switch would be. Three columns, two on a phone (play-menu.md). */ #pause .tiles { /* 80px: the card's 16px gutter, padding and border a side. */ width: min(660px, calc(100vw - 80px)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px 18px; margin: 4px 0 10px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); } #pause label.tile, #pause button.set-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; margin: 0; padding: 2px 0; text-align: left; line-height: 1.15; cursor: pointer; } #pause button.set-link { width: auto; border: 0; background: none; box-shadow: none; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-weight: 800; } #pause button.set-link:active { transform: none; } #pause button.set-link:hover > span, #pause button.set-link:focus-visible > span { text-decoration: underline 3px; } /* The arrow sits where the rows' switches sit. */ #pause button.set-link::after { content: '\203A'; flex: none; width: 54px; font: 900 30px/1 var(--head); text-align: center; } #pause label.tile[hidden] { display: none; } /* A phone: two columns that may shrink, smaller switches, and no drawings, so each label keeps its line. */ @media (max-width: 560px) { #pause .tiles { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); column-gap: 12px; font-size: 14px; } #pause .tiles svg { display: none; } #pause .tiles .switch { width: 44px; height: 26px; } #pause .tiles .switch::before { width: 10px; height: 10px; } #pause .tiles .switch:checked::before { transform: translateX(18px); } #pause button.set-link::after { width: 44px; } } #pause label.tile > svg, #pause button.set-link > svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } #pause label.tile > span:first-of-type, #pause button.set-link > span { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } #pause .tile small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; } /* Toggle aim: the mouse's right button is lit, and the line under the label says what a right click does now. */ #pause .mouse .lit { fill: var(--red); stroke: none; } #pause .tile .when-on, #pause .tile:has(input:checked) .when-off { display: none; } #pause .tile:has(input:checked) .when-on { display: block; } /* Dev map pins' rows (dev/pins.ts): the words on the left, a chunky switch on the right. */ #pause label.switch-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin: 12px 0; cursor: pointer; } #pause .switch-row small { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; } #pause-gpu { margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 6px 10px; background: var(--yellow); border: 3px solid var(--ink); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; } #pause .switch { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; position: relative; flex: none; width: 54px; height: 30px; margin: 0; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s; } #pause .switch::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--paper); transition: transform 0.12s; } #pause .switch:checked { background: var(--green); } #pause .switch:checked::before { background: var(--yellow); transform: translateX(24px); } #pause .switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } #pause button { margin-top: 8px; width: 100%; } /* One row, no words: the code (big enough to read out), COPY for the code, a chain for the link. */ #pause-invite { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 12px; border: 2px dashed var(--ink); background: #fffbe9; } #pause-invite[hidden] { display: none; } #pause-invite b { flex: 1; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.18em; user-select: all; } #pause #pause-invite button { flex: none; height: 44px; margin: 0; } #pause #pause-invite-copy, #pause #pause-lock, #pause #pause-bots { width: auto; } #pause #pause-lock[hidden], #pause #pause-bots[hidden] { display: none; } #left, #boot-fail { position: fixed; min-width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 32px)); z-index: 5; } #left p, #boot-fail p { margin: 0 0 6px; font-weight: 800; } #left button, #boot-fail button { width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; } .left-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .pause-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; } .pause-gap { flex: 1; } #pause .icon-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; width: 44px; height: 44px; margin: 0; padding: 0; } #pause .icon-btn.labelled { width: auto; padding: 0 12px 0 10px; } /* Narrow screens: the labelled buttons keep only their icons, so the bar fits in one row. */ @media (max-width: 480px) { #pause .icon-btn.labelled { width: 44px; padding: 0; font-size: 0; } } #pause .icon-btn svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } /* The Discord link is an <a>: it gets the ghost button's look by hand. Its logo is filled. */ #pause a.icon-btn { box-sizing: border-box; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } #pause a.icon-btn:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } #pause .icon-btn svg.logo { fill: currentColor; stroke: none; } /* Fullscreen in the pause bar shows the arrows of what a click does. */ #fullscreen-btn .fs-exit, #fullscreen-btn[aria-pressed='true'] .fs-enter { display: none; } #fullscreen-btn[aria-pressed='true'] .fs-exit { display: block; } /* Graphics: a slider row whose groove is a pill of three presets, the chosen one yellow. */ #pause .gfx-row { font-weight: 800; } #pause .seg { grid-area: range; display: flex; overflow: hidden; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); } #pause .seg button { flex: 1; margin: 0; padding: 7px 0; border-radius: 0; border: 0; border-left: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); box-shadow: none; font-size: 14px; } #pause .seg button:first-child { border-left: 0; } #pause .seg button:hover { background: #fff; } #pause .seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.18); } #pause .seg button:active { transform: none; box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.3); } /* Friends Weekend: the pause card's line about packs, kills and players (weekendGame.ts). */ #weekend-line { margin: 10px 0 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: center; color: var(--yellow, #ffd23f); } #weekend-line[hidden] { display: none; } /* The event's squad line in a friends room (eventTexts.ts, item 527). */ #pause-squad { margin: 10px 0 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: center; color: var(--yellow, #ffd23f); } #pause-squad[hidden] { display: none; } /* The host's Bots switch: what the next match brings (weekendBots.ts). */ #pause-bots-note { margin: 6px 0 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: center; } #pause-bots-note[hidden] { display: none; }
