/* Key bindings (item 146): one row per action, the key on the right; a key used twice is marked. */ #pause .keys-note { min-height: 2.6em; margin: 4px 0 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.8; } #pause .keys-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px 14px; margin-bottom: 10px; } #pause .keys-list button { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 7px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } #pause .keys-list button kbd { min-width: 2.6em; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; } #pause .keys-list button.clash kbd { background: #d63a3a; } #pause .keys-list button.listening { background: #ffd84a; } @media (max-width: 560px) { #pause .keys-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } #pause-settings.keys-open > :not(#pause-keys), #pause-settings:not(.keys-open) > #pause-keys { display: none; }
/* The pause card's main view: three labelled buttons under CLICK TO PLAY, and a small label over the friends room. */ .pause-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; } #pause .pause-actions button { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; margin: 0; padding: 0 6px; font-size: 14px; } #pause .pause-actions svg { flex: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } @media (max-width: 400px) { #pause .pause-actions button { flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 4px 2px; font-size: 12px; } } #pause-invite { flex-wrap: wrap; } #pause-invite .pause-label { flex: 0 0 100%; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.12em; opacity: 0.7; } /* The settings view: the title and BACK stay in view, the list between them scrolls when the window is short. */ #pause .set-scroll { max-height: calc(100dvh - 210px); overflow-y: auto; padding-right: 4px; }
/* ==== game-results.css ==== */ /* game-results.css: part of index.html's styles, linked from it in order (the cascade depends on the order). */ /* Cards: scoreboard, results, death */ .card { left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); min-width: min(560px, calc(100vw - 32px)); padding: 16px 20px; background: var(--paper); border: 4px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--ink); } .card h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 900 24px var(--head); } /* A friends match's room code, a sticker on the scoreboard's top edge: the title keeps its one line (hud.ts, showScoreboard). */ #scoreboard .room { position: absolute; top: -20px; right: 18px; padding: 2px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; transform: rotate(2deg); } /* The player's stickman lying on the card's top edge, top left (lounger.ts). */ .card .lounger { position: absolute; left: 10px; bottom: calc(100% + 3px); pointer-events: none; } #scoreboard .server { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 12px; text-align: right; opacity: 0.6; } #scoreboard .room b { margin-left: 4px; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .card table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .card th { text-align: left; font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 6px; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); } .card td { padding: 4px 6px; font-weight: 800; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.3); } /* One line per row: a long name ends with "…" and the hat tag stays beside it. */ .card td:nth-child(2) { width: 100%; max-width: 0; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; } .card td:nth-child(2) > span:not([class]) { display: inline-block; max-width: 10em; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; vertical-align: middle; } .card tr.me td { background: var(--yellow); } .card .n { text-align: right; } #death { top: 66%; min-width: 0; text-align: center; background: var(--red); color: #fff; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-1.5deg); } #death .who { font: 900 20px var(--head); } #death .who span { -webkit-text-stroke: 3px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; } #death kbd { display: inline-block; margin: 0 4px; padding: 0 6px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); font: 900 13px var(--head); } #death .dealt { margin: 2px 0 4px; font: 800 14px var(--head); } /* The killer's title, under their name (item 830). */ #death .title-line { margin: 0 0 2px; font: 800 12px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.75; } /* The killer's hat and how to get it (item 529). */ #death .hat-line { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 800 12px var(--head); opacity: 0.9; } #death .go { font: 900 15px var(--head); } #death .hint { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.85; } /* The event's line in a public match (eventTexts.ts, item 527). */ #death .event-line { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--yellow, #ffd23f); } /* Team modes: one column per team on the scoreboard and the results. */ .card.wide { min-width: min(860px, calc(100vw - 32px)); } .card .teams { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px; } .card h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 900 18px var(--head); } .team-name { -webkit-text-stroke: 3px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; } /* The results screen's map vote, keys 1 to 4 or a click; the map just played first (hud.ts, voteHtml). */ /* Sixteen rows and the vote outgrow a short screen. Clicks reach the map cards. */ #results { max-height: calc(100vh - 24px); overflow-y: auto; pointer-events: auto; transition: opacity 0.35s; } /* The winners' intro (podium.ts) fills the screen first; the card fades in after it. */ #results.intro { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } /* The owner's powers (hud.ts, showOwnerMenu; owner-powers.md). */ #owner-menu { width: max-content; min-width: 0; left: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); padding: 10px 14px; font: 700 13px var(--head); } #owner-menu[hidden] { display: none; } #owner-menu h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 900 13px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.06em; } #owner-menu ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 4px; } #owner-menu li.on { color: #b07d00; } /* * Rows and the close cross are buttons for a free pointer's click. They take pointer events * again over .hud's pointer-events: none, as #loadout's do. */ #owner-menu button { all: unset; pointer-events: auto; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 2px 4px; cursor: pointer; } #owner-menu button:hover { background: var(--yellow); } #owner-menu h3 { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } #owner-menu .hint { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 600 11px var(--font); opacity: 0.75; } #owner-menu h3 .close { width: auto; padding: 0 6px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); } #owner-menu kbd { display: inline-block; min-width: 18px; margin-right: 8px; padding: 0 4px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); font: 900 12px var(--font); text-align: center; } #podium-title { left: 50%; top: 7%; transform: translateX(-50%); text-align: center; color: #fff; font: 900 64px/1 var(--head); -webkit-text-stroke: 8px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none; animation: podium-title 0.5s ease-out; } #podium-title[hidden] { display: none; } #podium-title small { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 26px; color: var(--yellow); -webkit-text-stroke: 5px var(--ink); } @keyframes podium-title { 0% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(2); opacity: 0; } 60% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.95); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); } } /* This match's XP with the level bar, and the pack meter as one pip a match (hud.ts, rewardsHtml). */ #results .mr-xp, #results .mr-meter { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; margin: 10px auto 0; max-width: 360px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } #results .mr-xp b { min-width: 7ch; text-align: right; } #results .mr-lv { padding: 1px 6px; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); border: 2px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 12px var(--head); white-space: nowrap; } #results .mr-bar { flex: 1; height: 10px; background: var(--paper); border: 2px solid var(--ink); } #results .mr-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--blue); } #results .mr-pips { display: flex; gap: 4px; } #results .mr-pips i { width: 14px; height: 14px; background: var(--paper); border: 2px solid var(--ink); } #results .mr-pips i.on { background: var(--red); } /* resultsCount.ts: the new pip, a new level and the card pack stamp drop in with a bounce. */ #results .pop { animation: mr-pop 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.8, 0.5, 1); } @keyframes mr-pop { from { transform: scale(2.2) rotate(-8deg); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } } /* The level badge is redrawn every frame of the count, so an animation would restart: it flashes instead. */ #results .mr-lv.pop { animation: none; transform: scale(1.3); background: var(--red); color: #fff; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #results .pop { animation: none; } } /* A pack waits: a red button, a click or O opens it (hudScores.ts, rewardsHtml). */ #results .pack-line { display: flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; margin: 10px auto 0; padding: 4px 14px 4px 8px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--red); color: #fff; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.06em; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } #results .pack-line .pack-fan { width: 28px; height: 24px; flex: none; } /* The O key cap. */ #results .pack-line kbd { min-width: 1.5em; padding: 0 5px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-bottom-width: 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; text-align: center; } #results .pack-line:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); } #results .pack-line:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink); } #pause-packs { display: block; margin: 10px auto 0; padding: 8px 18px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--red); color: #fff; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.04em; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } #pause-team { display: block; margin: 10px auto 0; padding: 8px 18px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--blue, #2f6df0); color: #fff; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.04em; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } #pause-team:disabled { background: #aaa; box-shadow: none; cursor: default; } #results .vote { margin-top: 14px; } #results .vote h3 { text-align: center; } #results .maps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(96px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; } #results .map { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 6px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fffbe9; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); font: 800 11px var(--font); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } #results .map:hover { background: #fff3c4; } #results .map.on { background: var(--yellow); transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 var(--ink); } #results .map img { width: 100%; height: clamp(40px, 9vh, 90px); object-fit: cover; border: 2px solid var(--ink); } #results .map b { font: 900 15px var(--head); } #results .map kbd, #results .map i { position: absolute; top: 2px; padding: 0 6px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); font: 900 13px var(--head); } #results .map kbd { left: 2px; background: var(--paper); } #results .map i { right: 2px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-size: 10px; font-style: normal; } #results .map em { padding: 0 5px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); font: 900 9px var(--head); font-style: normal; } #results > p { text-align: center; } /* Daily challenges done or moved in this match (hudScores.ts, dailyCard.ts); the roll flips in. */ #results .mr-daily { margin: 10px auto 0; padding: 6px 12px; max-width: 420px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); text-align: left; } #results .mr-daily h4 { margin: -6px -12px 4px; padding: 3px 12px; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-align: center; } #results .mr-daily p { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 2px 10px; margin: 3px 0 0; font-weight: 800; } #results .mr-daily em { font-style: normal; opacity: 0.75; } #results .mr-daily .ok { color: var(--green); } #results .mr-daily .roll { padding: 1px 8px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow, #ffd23f); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 900; animation: mr-flip 0.6s ease-out both; } #results .mr-daily .roll.miss { background: #ddd; } #results .mr-daily .roll.all { background: var(--red); color: #fff; } @keyframes mr-flip { from { transform: rotateX(90deg); } to { transform: rotateX(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #results .mr-daily .roll { animation: none; } } /* Friends Weekend: the pack, or the reason it did not come (weekendGame.ts). */ #results .weekend-line { margin: 10px 0 0; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--yellow, #ffd23f); } /* Friends Weekend in a public match (item 219): a plum sticker with the gold MAKE A ROOM, like the home page's event section (weekendGame.ts, weekendInvite). */ #results .weekend-invite { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 14px; margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #3d1f52; color: #fff; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } #results .wi-got { flex-basis: 100%; margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--yellow); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } #results .wi-line { flex: 1; min-width: 180px; margin: 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } #results .wi-line small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; opacity: 0.8; } #results .wi-cta { padding: 8px 16px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 16px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } #results .wi-cta:hover { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); }
/* ==== game-loadout.css ==== */ /* game-loadout.css: part of index.html's styles, linked from it in order (the cascade depends on the order). */ /* * The loadout strip (hud.ts, showLoadout): the death box and countdown at the top, four slots * and the deploy button along the bottom, so the kill cam stays in view. Design: heavy-weapons.md. */ #loadout { inset: 0; } /* The strip takes the bottom of the screen: the fight's panels there wait until it closes. */ body.lo-open #vitals, body.lo-open #health, body.lo-open #gear, body.lo-open #xpbar { visibility: hidden; } #loadout::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 300px; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.6) 40%); } #loadout button { pointer-events: auto; font-family: inherit; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } #loadout kbd { display: inline-block; padding: 0 6px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); font: 900 12px var(--head); } /* * Over the middle of the strip: who killed you, and on its own card how much of their health * you took. While a slot's choices are open they step up, clear of the choices. */ #loadout .lo-top { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: calc(100% + 48px); transform: translateX(-50%); display: grid; gap: 10px; width: 300px; transition: bottom 0.15s; } #loadout .lo-strip.popped .lo-top { bottom: calc(100% + 190px); } #loadout .lo-card { padding: 8px 14px 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); color: var(--ink); text-align: center; } #loadout .lo-card small { display: block; font: 800 11px var(--font); letter-spacing: 0.1em; opacity: 0.75; } #loadout .lo-card .name { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font: 900 28px var(--head); line-height: 1.15; } #loadout .lo-card .name > span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } /* The killer's colour, beside the name: coloured letters were hard to read. */ #loadout .lo-dot { flex: none; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; } #loadout .lo-bot { flex: none; padding: 1px 5px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); font: 800 10px var(--font); letter-spacing: 0.08em; } #loadout .lo-card .detail { font: 700 13px var(--font); } #loadout .lo-dealt-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; white-space: nowrap; font: 800 11px var(--font); letter-spacing: 0.06em; } #loadout .lo-dealt-row b { font: 900 16px var(--head); } #loadout .lo-dealt-bar { height: 14px; margin-top: 5px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: #e3d9c2; } #loadout .lo-dealt-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--red); } #loadout .lo-strip { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 40px; transform: translateX(-50%); width: min(1050px, calc(100vw / var(--hud-scale, 1) - 32px)); height: 124px; display: flex; gap: 12px; } #loadout .lo-slots { flex: 6; display: flex; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; } #loadout .lo-slot { position: relative; display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1.25; } #loadout .lo-slot.primary { flex: 1.45; } #loadout .lo-slot.heavy { flex: 1.75; } #loadout .lo-slot.nade { flex: 1; } #loadout .lo-chip { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto; justify-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } #loadout .lo-chip:hover { background: #fff3c4; } #loadout .lo-slot.open .lo-chip { background: var(--yellow); transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 var(--ink); } #loadout .lo-label { justify-self: stretch; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font: 800 11px var(--font); letter-spacing: 0.1em; } #loadout .lo-pic { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 0; } #loadout .lo-pic img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 52px; } #loadout .lo-chip b { font: 900 19px var(--head); white-space: nowrap; } /* The heavy slot: dark, a ring of kills, the weapon greyed until it is earned. */ #loadout .lo-slot.heavy .lo-chip { grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: none; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #3a3236; color: var(--paper); } #loadout .lo-slot.heavy .lo-chip:hover, #loadout .lo-slot.heavy.open .lo-chip { background: #4d4249; } #loadout .lo-slot.heavy.ready .lo-chip { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--yellow), 4px 4px 0 3px var(--ink); } #loadout .lo-heavy { display: grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; text-align: left; } #loadout .lo-heavy .lo-label kbd { background: transparent; border-color: var(--paper); color: var(--paper); } #loadout .lo-heavy .lo-pic { justify-content: flex-start; padding: 0; } #loadout .lo-heavy .lo-pic img { max-height: 32px; filter: grayscale(1) brightness(1.6); opacity: 0.6; } #loadout .lo-slot.heavy.ready .lo-heavy .lo-pic img { filter: none; opacity: 1; } #loadout .lo-heavy b, #loadout .lo-heavy .sub { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } #loadout .lo-heavy b { font-size: 14px; } #loadout .lo-heavy .sub { font: 700 9px var(--font); color: var(--yellow); } #loadout .lo-ring { position: relative; width: 56px; height: 56px; } #loadout .lo-ring svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: rotate(-90deg); } #loadout .lo-ring circle { fill: none; stroke-width: 8; } #loadout .lo-ring .track { stroke: #6b6066; } #loadout .lo-ring .fill { stroke: var(--yellow); } #loadout .lo-ring > span { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font: 900 12px var(--head); } /* The open slot's choices, above it, with a notch pointing down at it. */ #loadout .lo-pop { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: calc(100% + 18px); display: grid; gap: 8px; width: max-content; max-width: calc(100vw / var(--hud-scale, 1) - 32px); padding: 10px; background: var(--paper); border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); color: var(--ink); } #loadout .lo-slot.right .lo-pop { left: auto; right: 0; } #loadout .lo-pop::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 40px; bottom: -13px; width: 20px; height: 20px; background: var(--paper); border-right: 3px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink); transform: rotate(45deg); } #loadout .lo-slot.right .lo-pop::after { left: auto; right: 40px; } #loadout .lo-tiles { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } #loadout .lo-tile { min-width: 96px; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 4px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: #fffbe9; } #loadout .lo-tile:hover { background: #fff3c4; } #loadout .lo-tile.on { background: var(--yellow); } #loadout .lo-tile .pic { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 88px; height: 34px; } #loadout .lo-tile .pic img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; } #loadout .lo-tile b { font: 900 12px var(--head); white-space: nowrap; } #loadout .lo-tile .cost { font: 700 10px var(--font); } #loadout .lo-info { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 6px 14px; max-width: 520px; font: 600 11px var(--font); } #loadout .bars { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 180px; font: 800 9px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.04em; } #loadout .bars span { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px 1fr; align-items: center; } #loadout .bars i { height: 7px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ink) var(--v), #fffbe9 var(--v)); } /* The sight on a gun (item 860): under the name on the chip, and a row of sights in the pop-up. */ #loadout .lo-sight, #loadout .lo-sightchip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font: 800 11px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.03em; } #loadout .lo-sight svg, #loadout .lo-sightchip svg { width: 28px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linejoin: round; } #loadout .lo-sight .dot, #loadout .lo-sightchip .dot { fill: #ff2a4d; stroke: none; } #loadout .lo-sightrow { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } #loadout .lo-sightrow.none { font: 800 11px var(--head); } #loadout .lo-sightlabel { font: 900 10px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.06em; } #loadout .lo-sightchip { padding: 3px 8px 3px 4px; background: #fffbe9; border: 2px solid var(--ink); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } #loadout .lo-sightchip:hover { background: #fff; } #loadout .lo-sightchip.on { background: var(--yellow); } #loadout .go { flex: 1.3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--red); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 24px var(--head); color: #fff !important; } #loadout .go:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ff6464; } #loadout .go:disabled { background: #8c4f4f; cursor: default; font-size: 17px; } #loadout .go .lo-wait { font-size: 40px; line-height: 1; } /* The key on the button is big enough to read at a glance (owner, 2026-10-09). */ #loadout .go kbd { padding: 2px 14px; border-width: 3px; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.1; } #loadout .keys { position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: 10px; margin: 0; text-align: center; color: var(--paper); font: 600 12px var(--font); } #loadout .keys kbd { margin-right: 3px; padding: 0 4px; font-size: 11px; } /* Narrow screens: the slots wrap two to a line, the button below them. */ @media (max-width: 820px) { #loadout .lo-strip { height: auto; flex-direction: column; } #loadout .lo-slots { flex-wrap: wrap; } #loadout .lo-slot, #loadout .lo-slot.primary, #loadout .lo-slot.heavy, #loadout .lo-slot.nade { flex: 1 1 45%; height: 110px; } #loadout .go { padding: 8px; } #loadout .keys { display: none; } /* The choices open above the whole strip, which is as wide as the screen. */ #loadout .lo-slot { position: static; } #loadout .lo-slot .lo-pop, #loadout .lo-slot.right .lo-pop { left: 0; right: auto; } #loadout .lo-pop::after { display: none; } } /* The heavy-weapon meter above the ammo; yellow once the weapon is earned. */ #heavyhint { padding: 4px 10px; text-align: right; font: 800 13px var(--head); } #heavyhint.ready { background: var(--yellow); } #heavyhint kbd { margin-left: 4px; padding: 0 6px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: 900 12px var(--head); } /* Team score in the timer: each side in its team's colour. */ #timer .tscore { display: inline-block; padding: 0 8px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--team); color: #fff; font-size: 16px; vertical-align: 3px; -webkit-text-stroke: 3px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; } /* Fixed widths, so the centred bar does not shift each second or when a score gains a digit. */ #timer .tscore b { display: inline-block; min-width: 2ch; font-size: 20px; } #timer .tclock { display: inline-block; min-width: 4ch; } /* "BLUE TAKES THE LEAD": one line under the timer for two seconds. */ #banner { left: 50%; top: 78px; transform: translateX(-50%); font: 900 26px var(--head); color: var(--yellow); -webkit-text-stroke: 5px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; /* One line, until it is wider than the screen (an unlock banner names the kind and where to find it): then it wraps. */ width: max-content; max-width: calc(92vw / var(--hud-scale, 1)); text-align: center; opacity: 0; } #banner.show { animation: banner 2.2s ease-out; } /* The next match's countdown (hud.ts, setCountdown): a big number that pops in each second. */ #countdown { left: 50%; top: 34%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); text-align: center; color: var(--yellow); -webkit-text-stroke: 6px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; pointer-events: none; } #countdown[hidden] { display: none; } #countdown small { display: block; font: 900 24px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.08em; -webkit-text-stroke: 5px var(--ink); } #countdown b { display: block; font: 900 120px/1 var(--head); } #countdown.tick b { animation: countdown-pop 0.6s ease-out; } @keyframes countdown-pop { 0% { transform: scale(1.6); opacity: 0; } 25% { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 1; } 40% { transform: scale(1); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } } /* A map drop's banner stays longer: it is the match's one event to run for (game.ts, 'drop'). */ #banner.show.long { animation-duration: 4s; } @keyframes banner { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.7); } 10% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.1); } 18% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); } 80% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); } } /* Team mates' names over their heads, those in view only (game.ts, nameTags). */ #tags { inset: 0; overflow: hidden; } /* White with ink reads on any wall; the team colour is the chip under the name. */ #tags div { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; padding-bottom: 5px; border-bottom: 4px solid var(--team); color: #fff; font: 800 12px var(--head); -webkit-text-stroke: 3px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; white-space: nowrap; }
#debug { left: 12px; top: calc(12px + var(--tl-shift, 0px)); padding: 4px 8px; white-space: pre; font-size: 11px; background: rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.85); border: 2px solid var(--ink); } /* "Show FPS" in the settings: top left, coloured by speed, under the small scoreboard (--tl-shift, game-hud.css). */ #fps { left: 12px; top: calc(12px + var(--tl-shift, 0px)); padding: 2px 8px; font: 900 13px var(--head); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } #fps.good { background: var(--green); color: #fff; } #fps.ok { background: var(--yellow); } #fps.bad { background: var(--red); color: #fff; } /* The high-ping note (pingNote.ts): orange, under the fps counter when it shows, only while the ping is over 200 ms. */ #ping-note { left: 12px; top: calc(12px + var(--tl-shift, 0px) + var(--tl-fps, 0px)); padding: 2px 8px; font: 900 13px var(--head); background: #ff9a1f; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } #status { left: 50%; top: 62%; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 6px 14px; font-weight: 800; }
/* ==== game-screens.css ==== */ /* game-screens.css: part of index.html's styles, linked from it in order (the cascade depends on the order). */ /* Loading screen (loading.ts). Every animation here is a transform, which the browser runs off the main thread, so the reticle keeps turning while the game compiles its shaders. */ #loading, #name-ask { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 50; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 16px; background: radial-gradient(rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.13) 1.6px, transparent 1.8px) 0 0 / 14px 14px, var(--sky); transition: opacity 0.35s; } /* The map's picture fills the screen, dimmed so the card reads; the card sits at the bottom (item 799). --loading-pic comes from loadingMap(); a map without a picture keeps the dotted sky. */ #loading { align-items: end; padding-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); background: linear-gradient(rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.25), rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.55)), var(--loading-pic, none) center / cover, radial-gradient(rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.13) 1.6px, transparent 1.8px) 0 0 / 14px 14px, var(--sky); } #loading.done { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .loading-card { width: min(340px, 100%); padding: 22px 26px 18px; text-align: center; background: var(--paper); border: 4px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 var(--ink); transform: rotate(-1deg); } .loading-logo { font: 900 34px/1 var(--head); letter-spacing: -1px; color: var(--red); -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } .loading-reticle { display: block; width: 64px; height: 64px; margin: 18px auto 10px; animation: loading-spin 1.6s linear infinite; will-change: transform; } @keyframes loading-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } .loading-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 900 20px/1.1 var(--head); letter-spacing: 1px; } .loading-map { color: var(--red); } .loading-bar { position: relative; height: 16px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; overflow: hidden; } .loading-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--yellow) 0 8px, #f2b81f 8px 16px); transform: scaleX(0.04); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.4s ease-out; } /* A light band sweeping the bar: it moves even when a step takes a while. */ .loading-bar::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 40%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7), transparent); animation: loading-sweep 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; will-change: transform; } @keyframes loading-sweep { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(250%); } } .loading-step { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; opacity: 0.75; } /* On the loading screen the card is a wide strip along the bottom: reticle, logo and map name in one row, the bar long and tall under them (owner, 2026-10-25). The name card keeps the small card. */ #loading .loading-card { width: min(1100px, 100%); padding: 14px 22px 12px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto 1fr; grid-template-areas: 'reticle logo title' 'bar bar bar' 'step step step'; align-items: center; column-gap: 12px; text-align: left; transform: rotate(-0.4deg); } #loading .loading-logo { grid-area: logo; font-size: 30px; } #loading .loading-reticle { grid-area: reticle; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin: 0; } #loading .loading-title { grid-area: title; margin: 0; text-align: right; } #loading .loading-bar { grid-area: bar; height: 30px; margin-top: 12px; border-width: 4px; } #loading .loading-fill { background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--yellow) 0 12px, #f2b81f 12px 24px); } #loading .loading-bar::after { width: 20%; animation: loading-sweep-long 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes loading-sweep-long { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(500%); } } #loading .loading-step { grid-area: step; margin-top: 8px; } /* A phone: the map name drops under the logo. */ @media (max-width: 560px) { #loading .loading-card { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; grid-template-areas: 'reticle logo' 'title title' 'bar bar' 'step step'; } #loading .loading-logo { font-size: 26px; } #loading .loading-title { margin-top: 8px; text-align: left; font-size: 17px; } #loading .loading-bar { height: 24px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .loading-reticle, .loading-bar::after, #loading .loading-bar::after { animation: none; } }
button { padding: 10px 18px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); font: 900 16px var(--head); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); } button:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink); }
/* XP: bar, gains, level-up stamp */ #xpbar { left: 50%; bottom: 14px; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: min(360px, calc(100vw / var(--hud-scale, 1) - 560px)); min-width: 200px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 11px; } /* The owner's level (glitch.ts): the level badge's own colours, two flickering characters instead of a number (owner, 2026-10-06). */ .glitch { display: inline-block; min-width: 2ch; font-family: var(--font); text-align: center; } #xpbar .lv, .lv-badge { padding: 1px 6px; background: var(--yellow); border: 2px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 12px var(--head); white-space: nowrap; } /* A score row's head with the hat worn (headPics.ts), and the hat's rarity tag. */ .sb-head { display: inline-block; width: 32px; height: 32px; margin: -8px 6px -8px 0; vertical-align: middle; } /* A worn title after the name on the score table (item 830): small, dim, no box. */ .sb-title { margin-left: 4px; font: 800 10px/1.4 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.6; vertical-align: middle; white-space: nowrap; } .hat-tag { display: inline-block; margin-left: 6px; padding: 0 5px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: #e6e0d4; color: var(--ink); font: 900 10px/1.4 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.06em; vertical-align: middle; white-space: nowrap; cursor: help; } .hat-tag[data-rarity='rare'] { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; } .hat-tag[data-rarity='epic'] { background: #f6b21b; box-shadow: 0 0 8px #ffd84a; } #xpbar .track { flex: 1; height: 10px; background: var(--paper); border: 2px solid var(--ink); } #xpbar .fill { height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--blue); transition: width 0.4s; } #xpbar .txt { -webkit-text-stroke: 3px var(--paper); paint-order: stroke; white-space: nowrap; } #xpfeed { left: calc(50% + 34px); top: calc(50% - 12px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .xpgain { font: 900 15px var(--head); color: var(--blue); -webkit-text-stroke: 3px var(--paper); paint-order: stroke; animation: xpgain 1.4s ease-out forwards; } /* XP taken away: a team kill with friendly fire. */ .xpgain.loss { color: var(--red); } @keyframes xpgain { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-8px); } 15% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } 75% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-14px); } } #levelup { left: 50%; top: 26%; padding: 10px 26px; background: var(--yellow); border: 4px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--ink); font: 900 34px var(--head); transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg); animation: levelup 2.4s ease-out forwards; } @keyframes levelup { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg) scale(0.3); } 12% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg) scale(1.2); } 22% { transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg) scale(1); } 85% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg) scale(1); } } button.ghost { background: var(--paper); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); font-size: 13px; padding: 6px 12px; }
/* RESET ALL SETTINGS asks once (settingsReset.ts). */ .reset-confirm:not([hidden]) { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 800; }
/* FEEDBACK and REPORT: views of the pause card, like SETTINGS. One shows in place of the main view, and the card keeps the main view's size (hud.holdPauseSize). */ #pause:has(> .pause-view:not([hidden])) > #pause-main { display: none; } /* The held height goes to the text box and the player list, so BACK sits at the card's bottom as on the main view. */ #pause:has(> .pause-view:not([hidden])), #pause > .pause-view:not([hidden]) { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } #pause > .pause-view:not([hidden]) { flex: 1; } #pause #fb-text { flex: 1; } #pause #report-close { margin-top: auto; } #pause .fb-kinds label { margin: 0; } #pause .fb-row button { flex: 1; margin-top: 0; } #pause .report-row button { width: auto; margin-top: 0; } .fb-lead { margin: 0 0 10px; font-weight: 700; } .fb-kinds { display: flex; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 800; } #fb-text { width: 100%; padding: 8px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); font: 14px var(--font); resize: vertical; } #fb-status { min-height: 18px; margin: 6px 0; font-weight: 800; } .fb-row { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .fb-note { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; }
/* Report view */ #report-list { max-height: 50vh; overflow-y: auto; margin-bottom: 10px; } .report-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.3); } .report-name { flex: 1; font-weight: 800; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .report-row button { padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; } .report-row .report-ban { color: #b3261e; } .report-done, .report-empty { font-weight: 800; opacity: 0.7; }
/* The votekick card (voteKick.ts): middle top, tilted like the death card, over the scoreboard. */ #votekick { top: 16%; z-index: 25; min-width: 0; width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 32px)); text-align: center; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(1.5deg); } #votekick h2 { font-size: 20px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } #votekick kbd { display: inline-block; margin: 0 4px 0 8px; padding: 0 8px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); font: 900 15px var(--head); } .vk-keys { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 800 15px var(--head); } .vk-count { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.8; }
/* "Enter your name" for a room link without a saved name (nameCard.ts): the loading card, over the loading screen's backdrop (#name-ask shares the #loading rule), with the home page's name field, error line and PLAY (landing-home.css .who-card, landing-site.css .join-error and .btn.big). */ #name-ask { z-index: 60; } .name-card .loading-logo { margin-bottom: 16px; } .name-card .loading-step { margin: 0 0 14px; } .name-card .join-error { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #b3261e; font: 800 15px var(--head); } .name-card .join-error:empty { display: none; } .name-card input { display: block; width: 100%; margin: 0 0 16px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 700 20px var(--head); text-align: center; outline: none; user-select: text; } .name-card input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--yellow); } .name-card.name-bad input { border-color: #b3261e; color: rgb(179 38 30 / 0.55); } .name-card.name-bad input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(179 38 30 / 0.25); } .name-card .btn.big { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 14px 34px; font: 900 26px/1 var(--head); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--ink); } .name-card .btn.big:disabled { background: #d8d3c8; color: #8d877c; border-color: #8d877c; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #8d877c; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; } /* A dead player's row, until they are back (item 767): dimmed, with a DEAD tag. */ tr.dead td, #mini-board .dead { opacity: 0.5; } .sb-dead { margin-left: 6px; padding: 0 5px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: #e8343a; color: #fff; font: 900 10px/1.4 var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
/* ==== game-emote.css ==== */ /* game-emote.css: the emote wheel (client/src/emotes.ts, docs/design/emotes.md). Linked from index.html. */ #emotewheel { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 40; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.35); } #emotewheel[hidden] { display: none; } #emotewheel .ring { position: relative; width: 0; height: 0; } /* Each slice sits on a circle round the middle, at its own angle (--a). */ #emotewheel button { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 132px; margin: -27px 0 0 -66px; padding: 10px 8px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); color: var(--ink); font: 800 15px var(--head); cursor: pointer; transform: rotate(var(--a)) translateY(-120px) rotate(calc(-1 * var(--a))); } #emotewheel button:hover, #emotewheel button.hover { background: var(--yellow); } #emotewheel button.locked { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; } #emotewheel button small { font-size: 10px; } #emotewheel kbd { display: inline-block; margin-right: 6px; padding: 0 5px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); font: inherit; } #emotewheel p { position: absolute; left: -120px; top: 0; width: 240px; margin: 0; transform: translateY(-50%); text-align: center; color: var(--paper); font: 800 12px var(--head); text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); }
/* ==== game-touch.css ==== */ /* game-touch.css: part of index.html's styles, linked last. Every rule is under html.touch, which only touch/phoneScreen.ts sets, so a desktop page draws nothing from here (docs/design/mobile.md). client/test/touchCss.test.ts checks that every selector starts so.
The touch HUD, laid out after Krunker's phone HUD (owner, 2026-10-09): top left II, the clock and the mode; top centre the kill feed; top right the small scoreboard; left thumb the stick (always drawn) with a second FIRE above it, health under it; bottom centre NADE, SWAP, RELOAD and HEAL, small; right thumb AIM, the big FIRE, JUMP with DUCK under it, the ammo card under them. Icons, no words. Panels zoom by --hud-scale, so their offsets divide by it. */
html.touch, html.touch body { /* No double-tap zoom, no pull to refresh, no text selection or long-press menu mid-fight. */ touch-action: manipulation; overscroll-behavior: none; -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
/* The layer under every HUD panel and card: it takes the fingers that land on the game. */ html.touch #touch { position: fixed; inset: 0; touch-action: none; } html.touch.touch-paused #touch { display: none; }
/* The stick: drawn at rest bottom left, and under the thumb wherever it lands on the left side. */ html.touch .t-stick { position: fixed; left: -60px; top: -60px; width: 120px; height: 120px; border: 3px solid rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.55); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.22); pointer-events: none; } html.touch .t-stick.rest { left: calc(40px + env(safe-area-inset-left)); top: auto; bottom: 70px; opacity: 0.7; } html.touch .t-knob { position: absolute; left: 36px; top: 36px; width: 42px; height: 42px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.8); }
/* Buttons: paper discs with the ink border and an ink icon, yellow while held or on. */ html.touch .t-btn { position: fixed; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 46px; height: 46px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.62); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.6); } html.touch .t-btn svg { width: 56%; height: 56%; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } html.touch .t-btn.on { background: var(--yellow); } html.touch .t-btn[hidden] { display: none; } /* The player's layout (touchLayout.ts): the HUD gives a moved button left, top and a scale, and one opacity for all of them. */ html.touch .t-btn { opacity: var(--t-opacity, 1); } html.touch .t-btn.placed { right: auto; bottom: auto; }
/* Right thumb. iPhone takes a swipe from the left edge as "back", so nothing sits within 24 px of it; every spot keeps out of the notch (safe area). */ html.touch .t-fire { right: calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-right)); bottom: 116px; width: 84px; height: 84px; background: rgba(239, 77, 77, 0.82); } html.touch .t-fire.on, html.touch .t-fire-left.on { background: var(--red); } html.touch .t-aim { right: calc(44px + env(safe-area-inset-right)); bottom: 216px; width: 56px; height: 56px; } /* A short phone (iPhone mini, 340 px or so): AIM stays under a four-line board. */ @media (max-height: 360px) { html.touch .t-aim { bottom: 206px; width: 50px; height: 50px; } } html.touch .t-crouch { right: calc(170px + env(safe-area-inset-right)); bottom: 34px; width: 52px; height: 52px; } /* JUMP left of RELOAD, which took its old spot (owner, 2026-10-09). */ html.touch .t-jump { right: calc(184px + env(safe-area-inset-right)); bottom: 98px; width: 60px; height: 60px; }
/* Left thumb: the second FIRE above the stick. */ html.touch .t-fire-left { left: calc(124px + env(safe-area-inset-left)); bottom: 198px; width: 58px; height: 58px; background: rgba(239, 77, 77, 0.82); }
/* RELOAD where JUMP was, centred on its old spot (owner, 2026-10-09). */ html.touch .t-reload { right: calc(130px + env(safe-area-inset-right)); bottom: 106px; width: 44px; height: 44px; }
/* Bottom centre, small, above the XP bar: NADE, SWAP, HEAL, EMOTE. The row ends 44 px right of the middle: the gun in hand fills the screen from about 48 px right of the middle down, so no button of the row sits on it (item 906; client/test/touchGeometry.test.ts holds the numbers at the common phone sizes). */ html.touch .t-throw, html.touch .t-weapon, html.touch .t-heal { bottom: 30px; width: 40px; height: 40px; } html.touch .t-throw { left: calc(50% - 152px); } html.touch .t-weapon { left: calc(50% - 100px); } html.touch .t-heal { left: calc(50% - 48px); }
/* EMOTE: beside HEAL, small; a tap opens the wheel (game-emote.css). */ html.touch .t-emote { bottom: 30px; left: calc(50% + 4px); width: 40px; height: 40px; }
/* USE: only while a pickup is offered, beside its prompt under the crosshair. */ html.touch .t-use { left: calc(50% + 96px); top: calc(50% + 14px); width: 54px; height: 54px; background: rgba(255, 216, 74, 0.85); }
/* A word under USE and HEAVY: the hints say "HOLD USE" and "tap HEAVY" (bombClient.ts, hudLoadout.ts). */ html.touch .t-use::after, html.touch .t-heavy::after { position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font: 700 10px/1 var(--font); letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--ink); text-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.95), 0 0 3px rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.95); pointer-events: none; } html.touch .t-use::after { content: 'USE'; } html.touch .t-heavy::after { content: 'HEAVY'; }
/* HEAVY: above SWAP, with its word under it in the gap above the row; shows once the heavy weapon is earned (key 4 on a keyboard; item 906). Not beside EMOTE: that put it, and its word, on the gun art. */ html.touch .t-heavy { bottom: 92px; left: calc(50% - 100px); width: 40px; height: 40px; background: rgba(255, 216, 74, 0.85); }
/* Top left: II, then the clock and the mode beside it. */ html.touch .t-pause { left: calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-left)); top: 8px; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 10px; } html.touch #timer { left: calc((88px + env(safe-area-inset-left)) / var(--hud-scale, 1)); top: calc(8px / var(--hud-scale, 1)); transform: none; text-align: left; }
/* Top right: the small scoreboard (its look: .mini-board in game-hud.css). A tap opens the full one, the next tap closes it. */ html.touch .t-board { position: fixed; right: calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-right)); top: 8px; min-width: 128px; max-width: 170px; font: 800 11px/1.45 var(--head); } html.touch .t-board.on { outline: 2px solid var(--yellow); }
/* Top centre: the kill feed, where the clock is on a computer. */ html.touch #killfeed { right: auto; left: 50%; top: calc(8px / var(--hud-scale, 1)); transform: translateX(-50%); align-items: center; } html.touch .kf { max-width: calc(100vw / var(--hud-scale, 1) - 440px); }
/* Bottom left: health under the stick, grenades and bandages beside it. */ html.touch #gear { left: calc(248px + env(safe-area-inset-left)); bottom: 18px; }
/* The fps counter sits where the pause button is: under it on touch. */ html.touch #fps { top: 66px !important; left: calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-left)) !important; }
html.touch #ping-note { top: 98px !important; left: calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-left)) !important; }
/* The cards keep their spot under the pause button; the computer's corner stack is in game-hud.css. */ html.touch #gpu-card, html.touch #fps-card { top: 44px; }
/* Keyboard hints mean nothing on a phone. The sight is picked on the pause card (#pause-sight). The loadout card's DEPLOY and RESPAWN are tapped. */ html.touch #sightkey, html.touch #sighthint, html.touch #gear kbd, html.touch #prompt kbd, html.touch #loadout .keys, html.touch #loadout .go kbd { display: none !important; }
/* The pause card's sight switch, built by touch/main.ts under TAP TO PLAY: a square with the sight's picture, one sight for every gun (owner, 2026-10-09). */ html.touch #pause-sight { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: 136px; margin: 10px auto 0; padding: 6px 6px 8px; line-height: 1; } html.touch #pause-sight small { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; opacity: 0.7; } html.touch #pause-sight img { display: block; width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; } html.touch #pause-sight span { font-size: 13px; }
/* Words for a phone: "Tap JUMP", "TAP TO PLAY", "II" (the .on-touch default is in game-hud.css). */ html.touch .no-touch { display: none; } html.touch .on-touch { display: inline; }
/* Cards fit a phone held sideways (about 390 px tall): they scroll inside instead of off screen. */ html.touch .card { max-height: calc(100dvh - 16px); overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; touch-action: pan-y; } @media (max-height: 500px) { html.touch .card { zoom: 0.78; max-height: calc(100dvh / 0.78 - 16px); } } /* A scrolling card clips what sticks out of its edge: the room code sits on the title's line instead of on the top edge (owner, 2026-10-10). */ html.touch #scoreboard h2 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } html.touch #scoreboard .room { position: static; margin-left: auto; white-space: nowrap; }
/* iPhone cannot lock landscape: this card covers the game while the phone is upright. */ html.touch #turn-phone { display: none; } @media (orientation: portrait) { html.touch #turn-phone { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; padding: 24px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 800 20px/1.3 var(--head); text-align: center; } html.touch #turn-phone p { margin: 0; max-width: 14em; text-wrap: balance; } } /* The picture: an ink phone on a sky screen, turned on its side and back, inside red turning arrows. */ html.touch #turn-phone svg { width: 156px; height: 156px; overflow: visible; } html.touch #turn-phone .tp-arrows { fill: none; stroke: var(--red); stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } html.touch #turn-phone .tp-body { fill: var(--paper); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 5; } html.touch #turn-phone .tp-screen { fill: var(--sky); } html.touch #turn-phone .tp-speaker { stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; } html.touch #turn-phone .tp-phone { transform-box: view-box; transform-origin: 48px 48px; animation: turn-phone 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes turn-phone { 0%, 20% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 45%, 75% { transform: rotate(-90deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html.touch #turn-phone .tp-phone { animation: none; transform: rotate(-20deg); } }
/* The layout editor (touch/layoutEditor.ts), over the paused game: the real buttons stay visible, the pause card steps aside, and a grid of tenths lies on the screen. */ html.touch.touch-editing #touch { display: block; pointer-events: none; } html.touch.touch-editing #pause { display: none; } html.touch .t-btn.picked { outline: 4px solid var(--yellow); outline-offset: 3px; } html.touch #t-edit .t-edit-pad { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 6; touch-action: none; background-color: rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.35); background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.18) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.18) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 10% 10%; } html.touch #t-edit #t-edit-card { position: fixed; z-index: 7; left: 50%; top: 8px; transform: translateX(-50%); min-width: 0; width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 32px)); padding: 8px 14px 10px; } html.touch #t-edit-card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; } html.touch #t-edit-card .t-edit-hint { margin: 2px 0 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; } html.touch #t-edit-card .t-edit-slide { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 84px 1fr 44px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 2px 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; } html.touch #t-edit-card .t-edit-slide input { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--red); } html.touch #t-edit-card .t-edit-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; } html.touch #t-edit-card .t-edit-bar button { flex: 1; padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 14px; } html.touch #pause-layout { display: block; margin: 10px auto 0; font-size: 13px; } /* A phone has no keys to bind: TOUCH CONTROLS (touch/main.ts) takes KEY BINDINGS' place in the settings. */ html.touch #open-keys, html.touch #pause-keys { display: none; }
/* Chat on touch (client/src/chatView.ts): the CHAT button under the pause button opens the line; the open line moves to the top, so the soft keyboard does not cover it, and SEND sits beside it. */ html.touch .chat-open { display: block; position: fixed; left: calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-left)); top: 68px; min-width: 52px; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78); color: var(--ink); font: 800 12px var(--font); pointer-events: auto; } html.touch .chat-open[hidden], html.touch.touch-paused .chat-open, html.touch #chat .chat-hint { display: none; } html.touch #chat.open { top: 8px; bottom: auto; left: calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-left)); width: min(520px, calc(100vw / var(--hud-scale, 1) - 52px)); } html.touch #chat .chat-send { display: block; padding: 0 14px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent, #ffd84a); color: var(--ink); font: 800 14px var(--font); pointer-events: auto; } html.touch #chat .chat-input { font-size: 16px; /* under 16px iOS zooms the page when the input takes focus */ }
/* The top bar shows the count of the living only (teamBar.ts, items 767 and 801), beside the minimap. */ html.touch #team-bar { left: 0; display: flex; gap: 6px; width: auto; padding: 0 0 0 276px; transform: none; zoom: 1; } html.touch #team-bar .tb-mid { min-width: 0; height: 32px; } html.touch #team-bar .tb-alive { display: block; } html.touch #team-bar .tb-score { min-width: 0; height: 32px; font-size: 16px; } html.touch #team-bar .tb-clock { font-size: 18px; } html.touch #team-bar .tb-mid small { display: none; } html.touch #team-bar .tb-heads { display: none; }
/* The minimap (minimapView.ts, minimapTouch.ts, item 762): 88 px top left, under the top bar and RIGHT of the second FIRE (its right edge is 124 + 58 = 182 px; the map starts at 190). Left of the FIRE it overlapped the button on screens under 388 px high (item 852: 863x360, 750x342), because the FIRE's top is 256 px above the bottom edge. Right of it, the map is clear of the PAUSE and CHAT column, the stick and every right-thumb button at any width the touch HUD supports. A tap takes the whole map over the veil, in the screen's middle; a tap anywhere closes it. The HUD scale does not apply: the sizes are real px. */ html.touch .minimap { left: calc(190px + env(safe-area-inset-left)); top: 36px; zoom: 1; z-index: 2; pointer-events: auto; touch-action: manipulation; } html.touch .minimap.whole { z-index: 6; } html.touch #minimap-veil { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 5; background: rgba(21, 17, 28, 0.6); touch-action: manipulation; }
/* ==== daily.css ==== */ /* Daily challenges (client/src/dailyCard.ts, item 284): the card in a match, and the shell (.daily) of the home card (rewards.css, item 800), linked from landing.html and index.html. Each challenge is its own small card, so a row reads as one task (owner, 2026-10-11). Where each copy sits: landing-home.css, game-hud.css. */ .daily { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 16px 16px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 800 13px/1.2 var(--head); } .daily[hidden] { display: none; } /* Over a row card's dashed perforation (landing-home.css, .row-card::after). */ .daily > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .daily-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px 10px; } .daily-title { padding: 3px 10px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 900 14px var(--head); letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .daily-left { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4252); } .daily-pay { margin: 0; font: 700 12px/1.35 var(--head); color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4252); } .daily-rows { display: grid; gap: 7px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .daily-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 6px 10px; padding: 8px 10px 9px; background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); } .daily-tick { grid-row: span 2; box-sizing: border-box; width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; font: 900 13px/18px var(--head); text-align: center; } .daily-text { font: 800 14px/1.2 var(--head); } .daily-count { padding: 1px 6px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: 900 12px var(--head); font-style: normal; } .daily-bar { grid-column: 2 / span 2; height: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); } .daily-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--blue); } .daily-row.done { background: #e2f5ea; } .daily-row.done .daily-tick, .daily-row.done .daily-count { background: var(--green); color: #fff; } .daily-row.done .daily-bar i { background: var(--green); } </style> <style id="sf-narrow-hud"> @media (max-width: 720px) { #health { width: min(220px, calc(46vw / var(--hud-scale, 1))); } #vitals { right: 10px; bottom: 10px; } #ammo { width: min(260px, calc(62vw / var(--hud-scale, 1))); } /* The toast is rotated -3deg, which pushes its box a few pixels wider than its computed width, so it keeps a margin from the edge. */ #toast { right: 16px; bottom: calc(124px / var(--hud-scale, 1)); max-width: calc(100vw / var(--hud-scale, 1) - 40px); } /* #xpbar is sized to sit between the health bar and the ammo card: calc(100vw - 560px). Below 560px of usable width that is negative, and its min-width: 200px then makes it overlap both corners. Give it the width it is centred in, and lift it clear of both. */ #xpbar { bottom: calc(84px / var(--hud-scale, 1)); width: min(360px, calc(100vw / var(--hud-scale, 1) - 20px)); max-width: none; min-width: 0; } /* The sight hint sits over the ammo card; on a short screen it lands on the weapon bar instead. */ #sightkey { display: none; } } @media (max-width: 460px) { #health { width: min(220px, calc(50vw / var(--hud-scale, 1))); } #ammo { width: min(260px, calc(66vw / var(--hud-scale, 1))); } #xpbar { bottom: calc(92px / var(--hud-scale, 1)); } } </style> <style id="sf-pips"> /* Sound-visualisation pips: the pool belongs to the frame loop, so the container lives here rather than in the HUD markup. */ #soundpips { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 3; } #soundpips:empty { display: none; } .sf-pip { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 34px; height: 20px; transform-origin: 50% 50%; transition: opacity .12s linear; border: 3px solid #15111c; border-radius: 50% 50% 8px 8px; opacity: 0; } .sf-pip.step { background: #fff4dc; } .sf-pip.shot { background: #ffd23f; width: 44px; height: 24px; } </style> <style id="sf-p2p-css"> #sf-p2p { position: fixed; Email sends a 6-digit code.</p> <button class="signin-line" id="signin-line" type="button" hidden><b>✓</b><span id="signin-line-text"></span><i aria-hidden="true">›</i></button> </section> <!-- EVENT & NEWS: one slot (havenEvent.ts): the event's poster from GET /events, the newest release under it. --> <div class="ev-slot" id="slot"> <p class="side-title">EVENT & NEWS</p> <!-- Overwatch: a small teaser card over the poster until players can review cases (item 443). --> <div class="slot-ow row-card" id="slot-ow" hidden></div> <a class="slot-poster row-card" id="slot-poster" href="#event" hidden></a> <a class="slot-news row-card" id="slot-news"></a> </div> </div> </div> <!-- The newest idea from the ideas board that shipped, for every visitor (ideasNews.ts, showIdeaNews): a small card on the stage's top-left corner. Hidden unless one shipped in the last IDEA_NEW_DAYS days. --> <aside class="new-card" id="new-card" aria-label="New in the game" hidden></aside> <div class="under-stage"> <!-- A room code a friend read out: straight into their match (playMenu.ts, joinByCode). Its own card under the stage, shown with the first step only. --> <aside class="code-card panel row-card" id="code-card" aria-labelledby="code-title" hidden> <h3 id="code-title">Got a room code?</h3> <button class="btn" type="button" id="code-create">CREATE A ROOM</button> <p class="code-or">or join with a room code</p> <form class="code-join" id="code-join" autocomplete="off"> <label class="sr-only" for="code-input">Room code</label> <input id="code-input" maxlength="200" placeholder="K7QX2M" spellcheck="false" autocapitalize="characters" /> <button class="btn paper" type="submit">JOIN</button> </form> <p class="join-error code-error" id="code-error" role="alert"></p> </aside> </div> <div class="gear-card panel" id="menu"> <div id="shipped-news" role="status" hidden></div>
<div class="menu-steps"> <div class="step" id="step-gear"> <p class="gear-invite" id="gear-invite" hidden>A friend invited you to their match on <b id="gear-invite-map"></b>.</p> <!-- Under the stage: who you are (name and level, or the name field) and a big PLAY. --> <form class="gear-join" id="gear-join" autocomplete="off"> <div class="who-card panel row-card"> <!-- Above the field, where the eye is while typing. A message also greys out PLAY (playMenu.ts, showNameError). --> <p class="join-error" id="gear-error" role="alert"></p> <label class="sr-only" for="gear-name">Nickname</label> <input id="gear-name" name="name" maxlength="16" placeholder="nickname" spellcheck="false" aria-describedby="gear-error" /> <p class="gear-who" id="gear-who" hidden> <b id="gear-who-name"></b> <button class="linkish" id="gear-rename" type="button">Change</button> </p> <!-- Level and XP from the last session (playMenu.ts, showLevel); the next level's badge names what it unlocks in its tooltip. --> <div class="xp" id="gear-xp"> <span class="xp-lv" id="xp-lv">LV 1</span> <div class="xp-bar" role="progressbar" aria-label="XP to the next level" id="xp-bar"> <div class="xp-fill" id="xp-fill"></div> <span id="xp-text"></span> </div> <span class="xp-lv next" id="xp-next">LV 2</span> </div> </div> <button class="btn big play-big row-card" type="submit">PLAY</button> </form> <div id="gear-phone" hidden> <a class="btn big js-play" href="/play/">PLAY</a> <p class="phone-note">Play on a computer. <!-- After PLAY: one button into the busiest match, or the full choice (docs/design/quick-join.md). --> <!-- After PLAY: laid out like step 1, so CREATE ROOM lands where the room code was, the modes where the "who" card was, QUICK JOIN where PLAY was. <!-- The server list, as before item 415: one row card per server, the mode chips filter it. --> <div class="step off" id="step-servers" inert> <button class="back" type="button" data-back><span aria-hidden="true">‹</span> BACK</button> <h2>Pick a server</h2> <div class="server-head"> <p class="server-title"><span id="server-title"></span> <select class="server-region" id="server-region" aria-label="Region" hidden></select></p> <span id="server-nobots-slot"></span> <button id="server-quick" class="btn" type="button">QUICK JOIN</button> </div> <div class="mode-chips" id="server-modes" role="group" aria-label="Game mode" hidden></div> <input class="server-find" id="server-find" type="search" maxlength="24" placeholder="Find a friend by name" aria-label="Find a friend by name" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"> <div class="server-cols" aria-hidden="true"><span>Mode</span><span>Server</span><span>Match</span><span>Players</span><span>Ping</span></div> <div class="servers" id="server-rows"></div> </div>

No bots.</span></li> <li><b>1 limited edition pack</b><span>Every player gets one after every private match. Up to <span id="event-per-day"></span> a day.</span></li> </ul> <a class="btn big event-make" id="event-make" href="/play/">MAKE A ROOM <span aria-hidden="true">›</span></a> <p class="event-fine"><b>Playing solo?</b> If you played 3 matches before the weekend, 1 surprise pack waits for you in a public match. Active players only: no reward when idle or playing in more than one browser.</p> <p class="event-rare"><b>Never again</b><span>These hats will never drop again.</span></p> </div> </section>

Ask a parent first. <!-- Row 3 (owner, 2026-10-16): the latest updates (src/updates.ts, written at build time), a row of their own under the thank-you row, open to every player from the first visit. --> <section class="duo updates-row" aria-labelledby="updates-title"> <div class="wrap"> <div class="latest"> <h2 id="updates-title">Latest updates</h2> <div class="releases"> <article class="release"> <h3>Smoother aim, fixes from your feedback</h3> <p class="when"><span class="name">Update 1.17</span> · <time datetime="2026-11-16">16 November 2026</time></p> <ul><li>Recoil climbs as hard as ever, but each shot moves your camera smoothly instead of yanking it.</li><li>Your gun no longer shows through walls when you stand close to one, and you no longer slide sideways after you spawn.</li></ul> </article><article class="release"> <h3>Pick your sight, a faster home page</h3> <p class="when"><span class="name">Update 1.15</span> · <time datetime="2026-11-11">11 November 2026</time></p> <ul><li>The loadout screen shows the sight on each gun. Click a gun and pick red dot, dot sight or iron sights in its SIGHT row.</li><li>The home page shows its 3D room much sooner on your first visit, and no longer freezes while it loads.</li></ul> </article> </div>
</div> </div> </section>

<!-- ================= PLAYERS: what the game is. Also the page's keyword text for search (docs/business/seo-plan.md): keep "free stickman shooter", "stickman FPS", "multiplayer", "Chromebook", the guns, the maps and the links to the four guides. ================= --> <section id="play"> <div class="wrap"> <div class="sec-head"> <!-- The page's h1 (the hero card's until 2026-10-06): search reads it first. --> <h1 class="page-title"> No download. No mercy. Just frags. <small>StickFrag: the free stickman shooter in your browser</small> </h1> <h2>A stickman FPS you can play anywhere</h2> <p> StickFrag is a free online multiplayer stickman shooter. You see the fight through your stickman's eyes, but the whole world is drawn like a printed comic: fat ink lines, flat colours and halftone shadows. You join a match that is already running, and bots fill it when few people are online. </p> <p> Team deathmatch and gun game for up to 14 players. No download, no account, and it works on a school Chromebook. </p> </div>
<div class="modes"> <div class="panel" style="--c: var(--blue)"> <h3>Team deathmatch</h3> <p> Blue against red, eight against eight. Pick a main gun, a sidearm and a grenade for every life: any of the twelve guns, from the SMG to the RPG. The sniper, the machine gun and the hand cannon wait between the two halves of the map. </p> </div> <div class="panel" style="--c: var(--yellow)"> <h3>Gun game</h3> <p> Every two kills give you the next gun: M4, AK, machine gun, SMG, shotgun, sniper, hand cannon, revolver, pistol and the silenced pistol. Then the knife: one knife kill wins. </p> </div> <div class="panel" style="--c: var(--green)"> <h3>Five maps</h3> <p> A fenced yard, a main street, a farm, a huge rail depot and a sea port. Up to 14 players fight in each match, 20 on the depot. </p> </div> </div>
<div class="controls panel"> <h3>Controls</h3> <ul class="keys"> <li><kbd>W</kbd><kbd>A</kbd><kbd>S</kbd><kbd>D</kbd> Move</li> <li><kbd>Mouse</kbd> Aim</li> <li><kbd>Click</kbd> Fire</li> <li><kbd>Right-click</kbd> Aim down sights</li> <li><kbd>R</kbd> Reload</li> <li><kbd>T</kbd> Change sight (red dot)</li> <li><kbd>Space</kbd> Jump</li> <li><kbd>C</kbd> Crouch</li> <li><kbd>Shift</kbd> Sprint</li> <li><kbd>1</kbd><kbd>2</kbd> Gun or knife (<kbd>Q</kbd> swaps)</li> <li><kbd>Tab</kbd> Scores</li> </ul> </div>
<div class="facts"> <div> <h3>Free, and fair</h3> <p>Money never buys power. Every gun is open to every player from the first match, and the server decides every hit.</p> </div> <div> <h3>No account, no tracking</h3> <p>You only pick a nickname. We set no cookies and build no profiles.</p> </div> <div> <h3>Any computer, no download</h3> <p> <a href="#works-on">Works on</a> Windows, Mac, Linux and , in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. You need a keyboard and a mouse; phones come later. </p> </div> </div>
<div class="works-on panel" id="works-on"> <h3>Works on</h3> <div class="works-cols"> <div> <p class="works-label">System</p> <ul class="works-list"> <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 4h8v7H3zM13 4h8v7h-8zM3 13h8v7H3zM13 13h8v7h-8z"/></svg><span>Windows</span></li> <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="12" rx="1.5"/><path d="M8 20h8M12 16v4"/></svg><span>macOS</span></li> <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M7 9l4 3-4 3M13 15h4"/></svg><span>Linux</span></li> <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 5h14v10H5zM2 19h20"/></svg><span>ChromeOS</span></li> </ul> </div> <div> <p class="works-label">Browser</p> <ul class="works-list"> <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3.5"/><path d="M12 8.5h8M8.9 14l-4-7M15.1 14l-4 7"/></svg><span>Chrome</span></li> <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 13a8 8 0 1 0-3 6.2M8 13h12a4 4 0 0 0-4-5"/></svg><span>Edge</span></li> <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M6 14c0-4 3-7 7-7 0 3 3 3 3 6a4 4 0 0 1-8 1"/></svg><span>Firefox</span></li> <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M15.5 8.5l-2 5-5 2 2-5z"/></svg><span>Safari</span></li> </ul> </div> </div> <p class="works-note">Keyboard and mouse. Phones: coming later.</p> <p class="works-note">Safari: mouse aim feels best in Chrome.</p> </div>
<div class="more"> <p> New here? Read , see , or compare . </p> <p class="creators">Make videos of StickFrag? .</p> <p class="tiktok"> <strong>Saw StickFrag on TikTok?</strong> This is the game. Press PLAY and you are in the same yard in ten seconds. </p> </div> </div> </section>
<!-- ================= One line for brands (while ads are off). The tip card moved up to the thank-you row (item 212). ================= --> <section id="support" class="support soon-only"> <div class="wrap"> <p class="brands-line"> <b>For brands:</b> the billboards, trucks and blimp in our maps carry made-up brands today. We open them to real brands once StickFrag has a real player base. Write to <!-- email_off: Cloudflare's email obfuscation added a script that threw on this page (2026-10-07). --> <a href="mailto:hello@stickfrag.com?subject=Ad%20space%20in%20StickFrag">hello@stickfrag.com</a>. </p> </div> </section>
<!-- ================= ADVERTISERS (CONFIG.adsLive) ================= --> <section id="advertise" class="plate live-only"> <div class="burst" aria-hidden="true"> <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100"> <path d="M50 2l8 16 17-8-2 18 18 1-12 13 14 11-17 6 7 17-18-3-2 18-13-12-13 12-2-18-18 3 7-17-17-6 14-11-12-13 18-1-2-18 17 8z" fill="#ffd23f" stroke="#15111c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" /> </svg> <span class="js-burst">Founding sponsors pay half</span> </div> <div class="wrap"> <div class="sec-head"> <h2>Put your brand on the truck everyone hides behind</h2> <p> StickFrag has no pop-ups and no video breaks. Brands are part of the yard: on the trucks, the containers, the blimp and the big screen. Players see them in every fight and call positions by them: “behind the cola truck!” </p> </div>
<div class="why"> <div class="panel"> <h3>Part of the world, not in the way</h3> <p> Your logo gets the same ink lines, sun shadows and halftone dots as everything else in the game. Send us your logo and we redraw it in the comic style, free. </p> </div> <div class="panel"> <h3>No tracking</h3> <p>No cookies, no profiles, no targeting. Every player in a match sees the same brand.</p> </div> <div class="panel"> <h3 class="live-only">A flat weekly price</h3> <p class="js-why-price live-only"> Prices start at a few euros a day. If fewer players come than we forecast, we add free days. </p> <h3 class="soon-only">Founding sponsors first</h3> <p class="soon-only"> The first brands in the yard get a founding price. Join the list and we write to you before anyone else. </p> </div> </div>

It carries the game name for now. <a href="#book">Ask us</a> if you want it. </p> </div>

<ol class="steps live-only" id="book"> <li><strong>Pick</strong>Choose slots and weeks with the calculator, then press “Book this campaign”.</li> <li><strong>Send your logo</strong>A PNG or SVG is enough. We turn it into comic art.</li> <li><strong>Check the preview</strong>Within 2 working days you get screenshots from the game.</li> <li><strong>Pay the invoice</strong>By bank transfer or card. Your campaign starts on your date.</li> <li><strong>Get a weekly report</strong>Every Monday: players, views and fresh screenshots.</li> </ol> </div> </section>
<!-- ================= RULES + FAQ ================= --> <section class="after live-only"> <div class="wrap"> <div class="sec-head"> <h2>What we accept</h2> <p>Many of our players are teenagers. These rules protect them, and they keep your brand next to a game parents are happy with.</p> </div> <div class="rules"> <div class="panel"> <h3><i style="background: var(--green)"></i>Good fit</h3> <ul> <li>Games and gaming gear</li> <li>Headphones and tech</li> <li>Clothing and shoes</li> <li>Streaming and apps</li> <li>Water and sugar-free drinks</li> </ul> </div> <div class="panel"> <h3><i style="background: var(--yellow)"></i>Ask us first</h3> <ul> <li>Sugary drinks and snacks: the rules differ by country</li> <li>Energy drinks</li> </ul> </div> <div class="panel"> <h3><i style="background: var(--red)"></i>Never</h3> <ul> <li>Alcohol, tobacco, vapes, nicotine</li> <li>Gambling, betting, loot boxes, crypto, trading</li> <li>Weapons and firearm shops</li> <li>Political or religious campaigns</li> </ul> </div> </div> <div class="art-rules"> <p> <strong>Art rules, so the game stays fair:</strong> no people or stickmen at life size, no shapes like a crosshair or a hit marker, no flashing, and no red splashes that look like a hit. </p> </div>
<div class="faq"> <h2>Questions from brands</h2> <details> <summary>How do you count a view?</summary> <p> A view is one sighting: your art is on screen, big enough to read, not behind a wall, for at least one second. The game counts views and our server checks and caps the numbers. Views come from players' browsers, so our reports call them estimates. Player numbers come from our servers. </p> </details> <details> <summary>Where do the forecast numbers come from?</summary> <p class="js-forecast-faq"> From our daily players, the average play time and how many players come back. You can see the exact numbers we use below the calculator. </p> </details> <details> <summary>What if fewer players come than you forecast?</summary> <p> We add free days to your campaign until it reaches the views we forecast when you booked. You never pay more than the price you agreed. </p> </details> <details> <summary>Do you track players or use cookies?</summary> <p> No. We set no ad cookies and build no profiles, and we do not target anybody. Every player in a match sees the same brand. That also keeps your campaign clear of the EU ban on profiling-based ads to minors. </p> </details> <details> <summary>Who plays StickFrag?</summary> <p> Players on desktop browsers, mostly in Europe and North America. Many are teenagers and young adults. They play in short sessions, often with friends. </p> </details> <details> <summary>Can I change my art during a campaign?</summary> <p>Yes, once a week, free. Send the new art by Thursday and it goes live the next Monday.</p> </details> <details> <summary>Is there a minimum?</summary> <p>One slot for one week. No contract after that, and no automatic renewal.</p> </details> <details> <summary>Will players see an “AD” mark?</summary> <p> Yes. Paid art carries a small “AD” mark, and the game menu lists our sponsors. The law requires that players can tell an ad from the game. </p> </details> </div>
<div class="final"> <div> <h2>Want a slot? Send us your pick</h2> <p>We answer within one working day. You only pay after you approve the preview.</p> </div> <a class="btn big" id="final-btn" href="#prices">Email us</a> </div> </div> </section> </main>
