<div id="sf-p2p" aria-hidden="true"> <div class="box" role="dialog" aria-label="Connect without a broker"> <h3>CONNECT BY CODE</h3> <p id="sf-p2p-help"></p> <textarea id="sf-p2p-code" spellcheck="false" autocapitalize="off"></textarea> <div class="row"> <button id="sf-p2p-copy" type="button">COPY MY CODE</button> <button id="sf-p2p-accept" type="button" class="dark">USE THEIR CODE</button> </div> </div> </div> <script nonce="hbDcUhS5tAM4Og8F"> // Broker-free join. The host publishes an offer code; the joiner pastes it and // gets a return code to send back. Fallback for when the free brokers are down. (() => { const el = (id) => document.getElementById(id); const panel = el('sf-p2p'); if (!panel) return; const help = el('sf-p2p-help'); const box = el('sf-p2p-code'); const show = (text, mode) => { panel.classList.add('on'); panel.dataset.mode = mode; help.textContent = text; if (mode === 'host') el('sf-p2p-accept').textContent = 'SHOW OFFER AGAIN'; }; window.__sfCodeUI = { show, panel, help, box }; // Escape closes it; C opens it again for the broker-free fallback. panel.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === panel) panel.classList.remove('on'); }); addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') panel.classList.remove('on'); if (e.key === 'c' || e.key === 'C') { if (document.pointerLockElement) return; // typing in game, not a shortcut show(panel.dataset.mode === 'host' ? 'Share this offer code with a friend, then paste their return code here.' : 'Paste the host offer code, then send the return code back.', panel.dataset.mode || 'join'); } }); el('sf-p2p-copy').addEventListener('click', () => navigator.clipboard?.writeText(box.value)); el('sf-p2p-accept').addEventListener('click', async () => { const api = window.__sfCodeApi; if (!api) return; if (panel.dataset.mode === 'host') { box.value = (await api.offer()) || ''; return; } const code = await api.accept(box.value.trim()); if (code) { box.value = code; help.textContent = 'Send this return code back to the host.'; el('sf-p2p-copy').textContent = 'COPY RETURN CODE'; } }); })(); </script>

1.17",title:"Smoother aim, fixes from your feedback",lines:["Recoil climbs as hard as ever, but each shot moves your camera smoothly instead of yanking it.","Your gun no longer shows through walls when you stand close to one, and you no longer slide sideways after you spawn.","Guns that have a red dot now always use it. Iron sights stay only on weapons without an optic, like the rocket launcher.","Hats from card packs now arrive in your locker, and Titles has its own tab beside HEAD, HATS and BODY.","On phones, USE plants and defuses the Pumpkin Bomb, and long matches stay sharp.","On phones, a HEAVY button takes the launcher or RPG once you have earned it, clear of the other buttons in landscape.","Blood only shows when the server says you hit, and typing in the feedback box no longer moves or switches anything."]},{date:"2026-11-11",name:"Update 1.15",title:"Pick your sight, a faster home page",lines:["The loadout screen shows the sight on each gun. Click a gun and pick red dot, dot sight or iron sights in its SIGHT row.","The home page shows its 3D room much sooner on your first visit, and no longer freezes while it loads.","Smoother matches: every room on a server now runs on one steady clock, so fewer skipped or doubled steps and less lag.",'The "Change sight" card stays up after your first shot, and the line under your ammo names the sight you have on.']},{date:"2026-11-03",name:"Update 1.14",title:"Smoother servers, fewer false errors",lines:['No more false "Could not load the game" message: the loading screen no longer gets stuck retrying after the game has loaded.',"On a slow connection you no longer get a pile of old snapshots: the server skips what you cannot keep up with and sends a fresh picture.","Smoother matches: the servers do their end-of-match and clean-up chores without stalling the game.","Settings has a Reset to defaults button that puts every setting back.","On a touch screen the minimap is small in the top left, and a tap shows the whole map.","Pumpkin Bomb: bots take different routes to a site, so attackers and defenders no longer all walk one lane."]},{date:"2026-10-29",name:"Update 1.13",title:"Wear your titles, and night maps count",lines:["Titles have their own tab in the Locker: pick the one you wear, and see how to earn the rest.","Your title shows next to your name on the scoreboard, and on the card a player sees when you take them down.",'Unlock banners now say what you got and where to find it, like "TITLE UNLOCKED: HEADHUNTER \xB7 WEAR IT IN THE LOCKER".',"A knife kill in the dark now counts on every night map.","Finish a match on Night Farm now also counts on the Farm at night."]},{date:"2026-10-27",name:"Update 1.11",title:"Locked friends rooms stay locked",lines:["A locked friends room stays locked through server updates: when the game updates and your room moves over, nobody new can slip in."]},{date:"2026-10-26",name:"Update 1.10",title:"Smarter bots in flag and bomb modes",lines:["Capture the Flag: bots come for your flag carrier from different sides and in groups, so camping a corridor with their flag stops paying.","Bots empty more of their magazine before they reload, and top up in quiet moments instead of after every short burst.","Knife bots are fair now: up close they need a moment to react, and a quick side step can make them miss.","Pumpkin Bomb: defenders rotate to the site under attack, bots spread out around a site, and they retake a planted pumpkin together.","Bots stay in a match until 8 players have joined (was 6).","The loading screen is a wide card along the bottom with a long progress bar."]},{date:"2026-10-25",name:"Update 1.9",title:"Fuller matches and a clearer mode list",lines:["Fuller matches: bots now fill a game up to 10 players on most maps, and still make room the moment a friend joins.","After PLAY, the game modes are one list, each with its own icon, so you see Team Deathmatch, Gun Game or Pumpkin Bomb at a glance."]},{date:"2026-10-24",name:"Update 1.8",title:"Haunted nights, a minimap and a new top bar",lines:["Haunted nights: Farm, Yard, Town, Depot and Port play under the moon, with lit lanterns and pumpkins everywhere.","Minimap: top left, turning with you, team mates as dots. Hold Tab for the whole map, with flags, bomb sites and the pumpkin.","The Haunted Crate is a jack-o'-lantern coffin now, and it gives 3 to 10 Haunted packs, rolled on a new screen after the match.","Pumpkin Bomb and Capture the Flag: a new top bar with the round clock and both teams' heads, the dead greyed out.","Pumpkin Bomb: hold the pumpkin with key 5, HOLD F TO PLANT anywhere on the site, and a pumpkin icon shows while you carry it.","Out of the round in Pumpkin Bomb? Watch a team mate through their eyes, click for the next one. A soft sound ends each round.","Port's bomb sites moved: A into the teal warehouse, B upstairs in the office, with tighter spawns.","Map vote: one vote beats no vote, and maps repeat less when nobody votes.","Every Farm pumpkin breaks now, the patch too, and some have carved faces.","Results screen: the card pack button always opens, and the daily challenges box fits the card.","Home page: one rewards card with TODAY and HAUNTED tabs, an orange event panel, and the weekly top for everyone.","Loading screens show the map's picture, and the spinner never stops, so nothing looks stuck."]},{date:"2026-10-23",name:"Update 1.7",title:"Capture the Flag and Pumpkin Bomb",lines:["Capture the Flag: take their flag to your base. First to 3 captures wins. On Depot, Hospital and Forest Hospital.","Pumpkin Bomb: attackers plant a glowing pumpkin at site A or B, defenders defuse it. One life a round. On Port, Town and Hospital.","Both are in the play menu with servers of their own, and bots fill the empty seats.","Dead in Pumpkin Bomb? Watch a team mate until the next round."]},{date:"2026-10-21",name:"Update 1.6",title:"Haunted Week: hats, hunts, new maps",lines:["Haunted Week starts on Friday 23 October at 18:00 your local time, and ends on 2 November.","Haunted Hunts: six event challenges with a Trick-or-Treat pack for each. Finish all six to be a Ghost Hunter.","The Trick-or-Treat pack: a new event pack, from the hunts and from the Haunted Pass.","New Halloween hats, from the Mummy to the Plague Doctor, plus a Ghost body colour. See them in your Locker.","Inside Hospital and Forest Hospital join the map vote when the event starts, and stay after it.","Pumpkin Night: a pumpkin pack look in orange and black, with a glowing jack-o'-lantern face.","Gore switches on with the event in the settings. It is off by default.","Kill card: see the killer's hat and how to get it.","Creators get a panel in the Locker with their link and code, and a rules page at /creators/.","The menu stage gets spooky before the event: a Witch Hat on the floor and a face in the lightning.","Invite a friend: your invite link now carries your code, and you both get a pack once they have finished 3 matches (up to 3 rewards a week)."]},{date:"2026-10-20",name:"Update 1.5",title:"Smoother servers, safer accounts, fair play",lines:["Smoother matches: the game servers lag less, and bots no longer make a server stutter while they plan their way around the map.","US players join the closer US server sooner.","Safer accounts: email sign-in cannot be locked by a stranger, and your progress, packs and hats are better protected.","Card packs and daily rewards are paid once, even when you play in two tabs or on two servers.","Fairer matches: standing still while wiggling the mouse no longer counts as playing, and lag tricks no longer help.","Overwatch: reviewers get a pack for votes, with a fair daily limit for each connection.","More signals for our reviewers to spot cheaters, always checked by a person before anything happens.","The site and the game are better protected against attacks.","A cancelled creator link can be claimed again."]},{date:"2026-10-18",name:"Update 1.4",title:"Overwatch, text chat, Haunted Week soon",lines:["Overwatch: watch a short clip of a flagged player, with every name hidden, and vote Cheats or Not. Each counted vote gives you a card pack.","Text chat in matches: press Enter to write, or tap CHAT on a phone. A word filter keeps it friendly. Turn it off in Settings.","Haunted Week starts on 24 October: Witch Hat, Pumpkin Hat, Jack-o'-Lantern, and a haunted crate may rise.","Farm at night comes with the event: play it with friends from 24 October.","A live drop ticker shows the latest pack and hat drops, and the home page lists the last 10.","See what other players put on their guns: your sight choice shows on your stickman.","The home menu is tidier: your Locker, packs and sign-in on the left, PLAY in the middle, room codes on the right.","EVENT & NEWS, bottom left, shows what is coming next, starting with Haunted Week on 24 October.","You pick your own name before your first match, and the game waits until you press PLAY.","Sign in is one small button in the left column."]},{date:"2026-10-13",name:"Update 1.3",title:"Sign in with email and keep your progress",lines:["Sign in with email: tap SAVE IT in the Locker, type the 6-digit code we send you, and your progress is kept.","Play on another browser or phone: sign in with the same email and you get the same player, level and hats.","No email? Keep a save code instead, and type it on another device to get your progress back.","The Locker on the home page shows your hats.","Results screen: tap the +1 card pack line to open your new pack at once.","Delete my account in the Locker removes your email and save code at once."]},{date:"2026-10-12",name:"Update 1.2",title:"Daily challenges, emotes and your own controls",lines:["Daily challenges: four new ones each day. Each one you finish can roll a card pack, and all four give a pack for sure.","Emotes: press Z, or the EMOTE button on a phone, and pick one from the wheel. The camera steps back so you see it.","Change the key or mouse button of every control in the settings.","Phones: move, resize and fade each touch button, and reset the layout at any time.","Phones: looking around no longer stops when your drag starts on a button.","Phones: no more sudden grey flash of the whole screen.","The pumpkins at the Farm stand burst when you shoot them.","Maps draw faster, so the game runs smoother on phones and slower laptops."]},{date:"2026-10-11",name:"Update 1.1",title:"XP for skill, and bots that reload",lines:["Kill streaks pay more and grow: +100 XP at 3 kills, +200 at 6, up to +500 at 15 and every 3 kills after.","A knife kill pays 200 XP, double a gun kill.","A bot kill pays half of a player kill, its headshot and streak bonus too.","The black stickman body (Ink) now unlocks at level 50.","You now see every stickman reload, bots too, and bots fill their magazine when the fight goes quiet.","Field of view: the slider now goes down to 50\xB0, and you can type any value from 40\xB0 to 120\xB0.","A smoother weapon switch: the new gun rises into your hands in one easy motion.","The home page loads faster on your first visit.","A room link asks for your name first, then takes you straight into that room.","Packs: NEXT PACK shows as soon as your card turns face up, so you can skip the rest of the reveal.","When the game server cannot be reached, the game tries a second route and tells you if a VPN or add-on may block it."]},{date:"2026-10-10",title:"Now on mobile",lines:["Play on your phone: open stickfrag.com on an iPhone or Android phone, hold it sideways and tap PLAY.","Touch controls: a stick on the left to move, drag to look, and FIRE, AIM, JUMP, DUCK and RELOAD under your thumbs.","Phones meet phones in public matches. In a private room, friends on phones and computers play together.","Phones pick their own graphics and stay smooth at up to 60 frames a second."]},{date:"2026-10-09",title:"Friends Weekend and 14-player rooms",lines:["Friends Weekend, 9 to 11 October: play a private room with friends, and everyone gets a limited edition pack after each match.","Weekend packs hold three hats that never drop again: the Pioneer Panama, the Pharaoh and the Black Hole.","Played with us before? Your first public match this weekend gives you a weekend pack too.","Every room takes up to 14 players, on every map and in every mode.","Bots leave once 7 players are in a room, and come back when it drops to 6.","Lost the connection or reloaded? You go back to the same room with your kills, deaths, streak, XP and team.","Steadier mouse aim in Chrome, also after you press Esc and come back.","Hip aim in Safari no longer turns too slowly.","Space closes the loadout card before a match, as it deploys everywhere else.","The host of a private room can switch bots on or off in the pause menu, from the next match."]},{date:"2026-10-08",title:"Toggle aim and cleaner reloads",lines:["Aim can toggle: right click once to aim, once more to stop (Settings). Holding stays the default.","No more double shot after a reload, a gun switch, a throw or a bandage.","Keys 1 to 4 on the kill screen open or close a slot of the loadout strip. They never change your gun by mistake.","A new ammo card: your weapon slots and the rounds you have left, in one place.","Each click of the mouse wheel is one weapon step; a fast spin skips several.","Paint splashes shrink away after about a minute.","Private rooms have a host who can lock the room and kick players.","Big fights run lighter: fewer far sounds play at once.","Sound that your browser stopped comes back with any key or click.","A thank-you page with a tip button for anyone who wants to help pay for the servers."]},{date:"2026-10-07",title:"Winners, packs and paint",lines:["At the end of a match everyone sees the winners in 3D, with confetti and fireworks.","After the results, 10 seconds at your spawn to look round: GET READY, then GO! Pick your guns in the meantime.","A new pack opening: tear the strip, and the foil changes colour as it turns.","Map drops fall under a parachute and stay 2 minutes. Several can be out at once, and every drop you take is a pack.","Bodies react to the gun: a close shotgun flips them, a sniper spins them off their feet.","Hits splash paint on the floor. A headshot makes a big critical splash.","The scoreboard shows each player with their hat, and how rare that hat is.","The grenade launcher is a six-shot revolver: no reload, then your own gun comes back.","Reload sounds follow the hands, bullets fly by, and far shots sound far.","The results screen counts up this match's XP on your level bar."]},{date:"2026-10-06",title:"Hats and card packs",lines:["Hats: unlock them with levels and challenges, and wear them in every match.","Card packs: three rare hats after your first match, then a pack every 5 matches. A hat you already own turns into XP.","Map drops: a pack falls in ranked matches with bots. Hold F to take it. Listen for its sparkle.","Pick your guns from the loadout strip on the kill screen, with a new heavy weapon slot.","The home page is your haven: your stickman in an armchair, with your hats and colours.","A server in North America. It opens once enough players near it are online.","Each map has its own number of seats, from 8 on Farm to 14 on Depot.","A HUD size slider in the settings, and sensitivity you can type in.","Teams wear blue and red kits. Level 2 now comes in about a minute.","Far gunshots fade out fast, so your own fight is easier to hear."]},{date:"2026-10-05",title:"Free for all",lines:["Free for all: a new mode. 15 minutes or 50 kills, and you pick your gun each life.","The play menu has mode buttons, map pictures and room codes.","See-through iron sights. A hit splashes in the colour of the player you hit.","Lower ping for many players: the game connects straight to the server when that is faster.","A touch-screen laptop with a mouse can play now."]},{date:"2026-10-04",title:"The new Depot",lines:["Depot is a new, bigger map.","Sights in every match.","Watch your own ragdoll fall after a death.","Guides for new players: how to play, the maps, the weapons, and playing on a Chromebook."]},{date:"2026-10-03",title:"A feedback button",lines:["A feedback button at the top of the home page: tell us what to fix.","If your browser runs without graphics acceleration, the game tells you why it lags and how to fix it."]},{date:"2026-10-02",title:"Port, team deathmatch and gun game",lines:["Port: a new map.","Team deathmatch with loadouts and a sidearm, and gun game with a crown for the leader.","Vote for the next map at the end of a match.","Grenades, bandages, and a shooting range to try every gun.","Slide, a kill feed, a higher jump, and windows you can climb in Town.","Your shots hit where you saw the target, even with ping.","Lost the connection?
